Return compliant when a certification or authentication of that judgment is shown; quote it. Return needs_review when the judgment challenged, or the page that would carry the certification, is not in the excerpts or is illegible.

defects.defect: The petitioner has failed to aver specifically that the grounds mentioned herein had been taken in the application for review and that it was dismissed by circulation
defects.requirement: The curative petition must aver specifically that the grounds mentioned in it had been taken in the application for review and that the review was dismissed by circulation (Order XLVIII, Rule 2(1)).
defects.trigger_words: dismissed by circulation; by circulation; taken in the review petition; grounds mentioned herein; REVIEW PETITION; in chambers; GROUNDS
where_to_look: Main Petition: averment that the grounds were taken in the review
Annexures: review petition and the order dismissing it by circulation
The paragraph near the "GROUNDS" of the curative petition, such as "the grounds raised herein were taken in the review petition, which was dismissed by circulation".
A valid averment states both facts specifically; compare its grounds with those in the review petition and the dismissal order's words "by circulation" or "in chambers".
The curative petition bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not the review petition's own averments.

3. Re-upload the required page with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: Page 74 of the PDF Court Processes Handbook.pdf
defects.ai_note:
The averment usually sits near the "GROUNDS" or in the opening paragraphs of the curative petition, worded as "the grounds raised in this petition were taken in Review Petition No. … which was dismissed by circulation on …". The order dismissing the review, often in the Annexures, reads "dismissed" with "by circulation" or "in chambers". Labels may be wrong; identify the curative petition by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a specific averment in the curative petition that its grounds had been taken in the application for review and (b) a specific averment that the review was dismissed by circulation.
Do not treat the review petition's own grounds or the review dismissal order as the averment; they only support it. A general statement that a review was dismissed is not specific.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found when the shown curative petition refers to the review but does not say that the grounds were taken in it or that it was dismissed by circulation, or when the shown dismissal order contradicts the averment; quote that line. Return compliant when both averments are shown; quote them. Return needs_review when the paragraphs of the curative petition that refer to the review are not in the excerpts or are illegible.
Return defect_found only when the complete, correctly identified filing part provides positive evidence of every element of this defect. Return needs_review when evidence is absent, partial, illegible, contradictory, or depends on unavailable Registry-only metadata.

defects.trigger_words: candidate at the said election; electors; Electoral College; joined together as petitioners; Presidential and Vice-Presidential Elections Act; nominated as a candidate
where_to_look: Main Petition: candidate or number of electors presenting the petition
The cause title naming each petitioner, and the introductory paragraphs stating that the petitioner was a candidate at the election or that the petitioners are electors.
A valid petition is presented by a candidate, or by twenty or more electors for a Presidential election, or ten or more for a Vice-Presidential election; count the electors named.
The election petition bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not a nomination paper or list of electors filed with it.

The cause title names each petitioner, and the introductory paragraphs of the election petition state the capacity in which it is presented, such as "the petitioner was a candidate at the said election" or that the petitioners are electors at that election. Labels may be wrong; identify the election petition by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) the election challenged being that of the President or of the Vice-President and (b) the petition being presented by a candidate at that election, or by twenty or more electors joined together as petitioners for a Presidential election, or by ten or more for a Vice-Presidential election.
Do not count supporters, witnesses or the Advocate-on-Record, or the same elector twice; count only those joined as petitioners in the cause title.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. where_to_look: Main Petition: statement of the right under which it is presented

The election petition bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not a recital of the election result or of the grounds.

Compliance needs (a) a statement of the right on which the election petition is presented, (b) made specifically rather than by implication and (c) founded on the Presidential and Vice-Presidential Elections Act, 1952.
Do not treat a bare description in the cause title, a narrative of the election result or the grounds of challenge as a specific statement of the right to present the petition.

defects.defect: Allegations of fact in the election petition are not verified by an affidavit of the petitioner or one of the petitioners personally
defects.requirement: The allegations of fact in the election petition must be verified by an affidavit made personally by the petitioner or by one of the petitioners (Order XLVI, Rule 6).
defects.trigger_words: solemnly affirm; deponent above named; DEPONENT; allegations of fact; true to my knowledge; VERIFICATION
where_to_look: Affidavit: name and description of the deponent
Main Petition: names of the petitioners in the cause title
The opening line of the Affidavit, such as "I, … the petitioner in the above election petition, do hereby solemnly affirm", and the "VERIFICATION" with the deponent's name at its foot.
A valid affidavit verifies the allegations of fact in the petition and is sworn by a petitioner in person, whose name matches the cause title, not by an agent or attorney.
The Affidavit bearing this election petition's Supreme Court cause title, not an affidavit of a witness or one made for another purpose.

defects.location_source: SCR, 2013, Page 48 of the PDF 2024011691-1.pdf
defects.ai_note:
The affidavit usually opens "I, …, aged …, the petitioner in the above election petition, do hereby solemnly affirm and state" and closes with "DEPONENT" and a "VERIFICATION" saying the allegations of fact in the petition are true to the deponent's knowledge. Labels may be wrong; identify the Affidavit by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) an affidavit verifying the allegations of fact in the election petition and (b) that affidavit made personally by the petitioner or by one of the petitioners.
Do not treat an affidavit sworn by an agent, an attorney, a relative or the Advocate-on-Record as one made personally by a petitioner, and do not treat a witness's affidavit as verifying the allegations of fact.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found when the shown Affidavit is made by someone who is not named as a petitioner in the cause title, or verifies something other than the allegations of fact; quote the deponent line. Return needs_review when the deponent line, the verification or the cause title is not in the excerpts or is illegible.
Return defect_found only when the complete, correctly identified filing part provides positive evidence of every element of this defect. Return needs_review when evidence is absent, partial, illegible, contradictory, or depends on unavailable Registry-only metadata.

defects.defect: The petition is not accompanied by a certificate from a Senior Advocate to the effect that the petition discloses one or more substantial questions for challenging the election of the President or the Vice-President, as the case may be.
defects.requirement: Every petition calling in question an election must bear a certificate from an Advocate designated as Senior Advocate to the effect that the petition discloses one or more substantial questions for challenging the election of the President or the Vice-President (Order XLVI, Rule 8).
defects.trigger_words: substantial questions; substantial question; Senior Advocate; certify that; challenging the election; discloses one or more
where_to_look: AOR's Certificate: Senior Advocate's certificate on the election petition
Main Petition: certificate printed with the petition, if any
A certificate stating that the petition discloses one or more substantial questions for challenging the election of the President or the Vice-President.
The name and the words "Senior Advocate" below the signature, showing it was given by an Advocate designated as Senior Advocate.
The certificate bearing this election petition's Supreme Court cause title, not a certificate given in another matter.

Curative Petition - Shared by Ivan.pdf
defects.ai_note:
The certificate is usually headed "CERTIFICATE", states that the petition "discloses one or more substantial questions", and is signed above the words "Senior Advocate". It follows the format of the curative petition certificate with only the certifying paragraph changed, and may be labelled as the AOR's Certificate or printed with the Main Petition; signatures are often missing from OCR, so check the visual detections. Labels may be wrong; identify the certificate by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a certificate on the election petition from an Advocate designated as Senior Advocate and (b) a statement in it that the petition discloses one or more substantial questions for challenging the election of the President or the Vice-President.
Do not treat a certificate of the Advocate-on-Record or of an advocate not designated as Senior Advocate, or the grounds stated in the petition itself, as this certificate.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when the shown certificate is given by someone other than a Senior Advocate or does not state that the petition discloses a substantial question; quote its operative line. Return compliant when such a certificate by a Senior Advocate is shown; quote it. Return needs_review when the certificate is not in the excerpts, its signatory is unclear, or it is illegible.

defects.defect: Proof of the security-for-costs deposit required at presentation of the election petition has not been established.

Proof of the security deposit is a cash receipt, bank draft or demand draft, often headed "Security Deposit" or "Security Cover", showing Rs. 50,000 or "Rupees Fifty Thousand" in favour of the Registrar or his nominated officer, usually filed as an Annexure. Return compliant when a shown receipt or draft establishes the full deposit, or a shown application seeks exemption from it. Return needs_review when neither the proof nor an exemption application is in the excerpts, or the amount or payee is illegible.

defects.defect: Application for condonation of delay has not been filed for an interlocutory or miscellaneous application being filed exceeding the applicable limitation.
defects.requirement: Where no limitation is prescribed by the SC Rules or any other provision of law, every interlocutory or miscellaneous application must be filed within thirty days from the date of the order or the cause. An application filed after that period must be accompanied by an application for condonation of delay.
defects.trigger_words: condonation of delay; delay of; days in filing; INTERLOCUTORY APPLICATION NO; MISCELLANEOUS APPLICATION NO
where_to_look: Application: date of the order or cause and the date of filing

The heading "INTERLOCUTORY APPLICATION NO." or "MISCELLANEOUS APPLICATION NO.", the opening paragraph giving the date of the order or cause, and the date line below the prayer; the annexed order where it is filed.
An application is in time when filed within thirty days of the order or cause, unless another limitation is prescribed; a later one needs an application for condonation of delay with it.
The application for condonation of delay bearing the same Supreme Court cause title and referring to this interlocutory or miscellaneous application and its days of delay.
Supreme Court Registry filing/refiling history or the relevant Registry order: use authoritative presentation dates and any period actually allowed; do not use a drafting date as proof of filing.

No.", "INTERLOCUTORY APPLICATION NO." or "MISCELLANEOUS APPLICATION NO."; it names the order or cause it rests on and is dated below the prayer. Return compliant when the application is shown within thirty days, or late with its condonation application. Return needs_review when either date is not in the excerpts or is illegible, or it is unclear whether a condonation application accompanies it.

Current Supreme Court Rules, applicable form, and any still-operative Registry circular for the particular proceeding and filing mode.
Visual pages: signatures, notarial or oath-commissioner endorsement, seal, date, and identification details that OCR may omit.
Main Petition, Synopsis and List of Dates, Annexures, and Applications only for cross-references expressly required by a verified current source.
Return needs_review when the complete affidavit or current legal source is unavailable.
how_to_cure: Option for Jubeex to auto-draft the Affidavit in support of the allegations of fact made in the petition, appeal or application; the User must have it duly sworn and attested by a Notary before filing.
Option for the User to upload the duly sworn Affidavit in support of the allegations of fact.
If the Affidavit filed is not proper or not duly sworn: Option for the User to upload and replace the Affidavit with a corrected version, duly sworn and attested by a Notary.
Option for the User to mark this defect as complete if a proper and duly sworn Affidavit in support of the allegations of fact is already filed with the petition, appeal or application.
defects.applicable_rule: Supreme Court Rules, 2013, applicable affidavit provisions; continued applicability of Circular F.No.57/Judl./2009 requires verification
defects.location_source: F.No.57/Judl./2009 dated Dated August 3, 2009, Page 5 of the PDF 2024042339.pdf
defects.notes:
The Affidavit accompanying the Petition must be duly attested/notarised. The Affidavit should contain the prescribed verification of the facts stated therein, the required paragraphs as per the prescribed format, the relevant page numbers corresponding to the Synopsis and the LOD filed, a statement confirming that the Annexures are true copies of the respective documents, and reference to the Interlocutory Applications filed along with the Main Petition, wherever applicable.

Duly Attested Meaning:- The Affidavit must be notarised and the corresponding entry must be made in the Notary’s register. The Affidavit should bear the prescribed notarial stamp/seal, including the registration/serial number (Need to check for square stamp). The deponent must also be duly identified before the Notary, ordinarily by an Advocate. Where the deponent appears personally without an Advocate identifying them, the Notary should record the mode of identification, such as identification through an identity document.

Where the deponent is not a resident of the city in which the Affidavit has been notarised, the Affidavit should contain the requisite statement/paragraph regarding this circumstance. The Affidavit should also contain the appropriate verification stating that the facts mentioned therein are true and correct to the best of the deponent’s knowledge and belief.
defects.ai_note:
Legal status: Needs legal verification. This status does not prevent a compliant finding when complete, legible filing evidence affirmatively satisfies every stated element. Return compliant according to the compliance instruction below. Until a current authoritative rule, form, circular, practice direction, statute, or binding judgment confirms the obligation and its applicability, convert any otherwise defect_found outcome to needs_review. Also return needs_review when any prerequisite evidence is unavailable.
The Affidavit usually opens "I, … do hereby solemnly affirm and state", ends with a "VERIFICATION" that its contents are true and correct to the deponent's knowledge and belief, and carries the Notary's square stamp with registration or serial number and an "Identified by me" line. Labels may be wrong; identify the Affidavit by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) an affidavit supporting the allegations of fact, (b) the verification, (c) the Notary's stamp with registration number, (d) the deponent identified by an Advocate or a recorded mode, (e) a non-residence statement where the deponent lives outside the notarising city and (f) references to the Synopsis and List of Dates pages, the Annexures as true copies and the interlocutory applications filed, wherever applicable.
Do not treat an affidavit from the courts below in an Annexure, or the AOR's Certificate, as this one. Stamps, seals and signatures are often missing from OCR; check the visual detections.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. After legal verification is completed, return defect_found only when a shown Affidavit positively lacks the verification, leaves the Notary's stamp or identification blank, or omits a required reference; quote that line and name the element. Return compliant when the shown pages establish every element. Return needs_review when the verification, attestation or deponent's paragraphs are not shown or are illegible.

defects.defect: The Vakalatnama from the Respondent(s) is not accompanied by a caveat despite the matter being neither admitted nor a notice being issued in the same.
defects.requirement: Where the matter is neither admitted nor has notice been issued in it, a Vakalatnama from the Respondent(s) can be filed only when accompanied by a caveat, wherever a caveat is permitted under the Supreme Court Rules,2013.
defects.trigger_words: CAVEAT; Caveator; Caveat No; Advocate for the Respondent; Vakalat Nama; Vakalath
where_to_look: Vakalatnama: the side on whose behalf it is executed
The executant's description in the Vakalatnama, such as "Respondent No. …", and a caveat headed "CAVEAT" naming the "Caveator" in the same matter.
A Respondent's Vakalatnama filed before admission or notice is valid only with a caveat, where a caveat is permitted; the caveat is a separate filing in its own set format.
The Vakalatnama bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not one executed for the courts below.
how_to_cure: 1. Prompt the User to confirm whether the matter has been admitted or notice has been issued. If not, and a caveat is permissible, Jubeex will auto-generate the caveat .
2. Option for the User to add and edit the caveat with Jubeex.
3. Re-upload the Respondent's Vakalatnama along with the caveat.
defects.location_source: No. F.37/Judl/2008 dated 21st November,2008, Page 41 of the PDF 2024042323-1.pdf Page 103 of the PDF Court Processes Handbook.pdf
defects.ai_note:
Legal status: Needs legal verification. This status does not prevent a compliant finding when complete, legible filing evidence affirmatively satisfies every stated element. Return compliant according to the compliance instruction below. Until a current authoritative rule, form, circular, practice direction, statute, or binding judgment confirms the obligation and its applicability, convert any otherwise defect_found outcome to needs_review. Also return needs_review when any prerequisite evidence is unavailable.
The Vakalatnama (also "Vakalat Nama", "Vakalath") states for whom it is executed, for example "Respondent No. 1" or "for the Respondent(s)". A caveat is a separate filing in a set format, headed "CAVEAT" and naming the "Caveator", often with a caveat number. Labels may be wrong; identify the Vakalatnama by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a Vakalatnama on behalf of the Respondent(s), (b) the matter being neither admitted nor on notice and (c) a caveat accompanying the Vakalatnama, where a caveat is permitted under the Supreme Court Rules,2013.
Do not treat the petitioner's own Vakalatnama, a caveat in a different matter, or a notice issued by the courts below as relevant here.
not_applicable applies when the Vakalatnama is for the petitioner, the matter has been admitted or notice issued, or no caveat is permitted. After legal verification is completed, return defect_found only when a shown Vakalatnama is executed for the Respondent(s), the excerpts show the matter is neither admitted nor on notice, and the Vakalatnama refers to no caveat; quote its executant line. Return compliant when the Respondent's Vakalatnama is shown with a caveat in the same matter. Return needs_review when the executant line, the stage of the matter or the caveat is not in the excerpts or is illegible.

defects.defect: A covered filer-created document is illegible or does not comply with the line-spacing requirement currently applicable to its document class and filing mode.
defects.requirement: Order VIII Rule 1 of the Supreme Court Rules, 2013 requires covered documents, other than original exhibits and certified copies of public documents, to be fairly and legibly written, typewritten, lithographed, or printed. Apply its spacing requirement together with any later operative direction governing the filing mode and document class; do not enforce D-66 and D-88 as contradictory unconditional checks.
defects.trigger_words: MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH; GROUNDS; PRAYER; VERIFICATION; IN THE MATTER OF
where_to_look: Each filer-created pleading, petition, affidavit, application, and synopsis: legibility and line spacing.
Filing mode and document class: determine whether a later operative circular governs formatting.
Original exhibits and certified copies of public documents: exclude them from this formatting check.
Return needs_review if document class, filing mode, or the governing formatting direction cannot be established.

1.1 Option for Jubeex to auto- apply double spacing.
1.2 Option for the User to apply double spacing using Jubeex
1.3 Re-upload option for the document.
2. Legible Scans
2.1. Option for Jubeex to OCR and create legible, clear versions of  the pleading, petition, affidavit or other document.
2.2 Option for User to re-upload the the pleading, petition, affidavit or other document with clear, sharp, legible scans
defects.location_source: SCR, 2013, Page 13 of the PDF 2024011691-1.pdf
defects.notes:
Note to tech - what paramemeters can we set to make this quantifiable 

Note from tech:- in first review during parse we will flag what parts are illegible/unreadable
defects.ivan_comment: FOR ORIGINALS ALSO IT IS ADVISABLE THAT A CLEAR TYPED COPY IS ANNEXED ALONG WITH IT
defects.ai_note:
Spacing and legibility show in the layout of the running text of the Main Petition, the Affidavit and the other typed documents, such as the paragraphs under "MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH", "GROUNDS" and "PRAYER". Garbled, broken or missing words in the text may signal a faint, skewed or cut scan. Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) each pleading, petition, affidavit or other typed document being fairly and legibly written or typed and (b) its text set in double-line spacing.
Do not judge original exhibits or certified copies of public documents, such as orders of the courts below filed in the Annexures, by this standard. Line spacing and scan quality are layout properties; check the visual detections for them.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when a shown page of a covered document is positively single-spaced, or illegible, faint, skewed or cut; quote the affected heading or line. Return compliant when the shown pages of every covered document are legible and double-spaced. Return needs_review when spacing or legibility cannot be judged from the excerpts or the visual detections, or only some covered documents were shown.

defects.defect: A filer-created document does not comply with the page-size or margin requirement currently applicable to its document class and filing mode.
defects.requirement: Apply the page-size and margin requirements in Order VIII Rule 1 and Order XV Rule 1 of the Supreme Court Rules, 2013 to the document classes each provision covers, subject to any later operative direction for the relevant filing mode. Do not combine demy-foolscap, A4, and petition-specific margin rules into one unconditional test.
defects.trigger_words: IN THE MATTER OF; MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH; QUESTIONS OF LAW; GROUNDS; PRAYER
where_to_look: Main Petition and each other filer-created document: actual page dimensions and margins.
Document identity and filing mode: select the rule or later operative direction applicable to that class of document.
Exclude reproduced lower-court records, original exhibits, and certified copies unless the governing direction expressly includes them.
Return needs_review where the document class, page dimensions, or controlling direction cannot be established.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for Jubeex to auto-reformat the petition.
2. Re-upload the Petition.                                    3. Option for user to re-fromat with Jubeex
defects.applicable_rule: Order VIII Rule 1 and Order XV Rule 1, Supreme Court Rules, 2013
defects.location_source: SCR, 2013, Page 13 of the PDF 2024011691-1.pdf
defects.ai_note:
Page size and margins are layout properties, shown by the page dimensions and the visual detections rather than by printed words; the text itself names neither. The Main Petition runs from its cause title through "MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH" and "GROUNDS" to the "PRAYER". Labels may be wrong; identify the Main Petition by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) the paper being demy-foolscap or 29.7 cm × 21 cm (A4) and (b) the Main Petition being on standard A4 paper with a quarter margin.
Do not take the size of a scanned exhibit or of a copy from the courts below as the petition's paper size, and do not judge size from body text that merely mentions a size.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when the page dimensions or visual detections positively show a page that is neither A4 nor demy-foolscap, or a Main Petition page without a quarter margin; name the size or margin shown. Return compliant when the shown Main Petition pages are A4 with a quarter margin. Return needs_review when page size or margin cannot be determined from the excerpts or the detections.

defects.defect: Translations of vernacular documents/portions/lines are not filed
defects.requirement: Where any Annexure or other document, or any portion or line of it, is in a vernacular language, a translation of it must be filed, as required by Order VIII, Rule 2.
defects.trigger_words: TRUE TRANSLATION; TRUE ENGLISH TRANSLATION; TRANSLATED COPY; English translation; Translated by; Translator
where_to_look: Annexures: vernacular documents, portions or lines and their translations
Text in Hindi or another regional language within an Annexure, and a page headed "TRUE TRANSLATION" or "TRANSLATED COPY" for it.
Each vernacular document, portion or line needs a translation covering it; the List of Dates and Index may describe it as a translated copy.
The translation carrying the same Annexure number and content as its vernacular original.
how_to_cure: Option for the User to upload the translation of each vernacular document, portion or line, placed with the document it translates.
Option for the User to mark this defect as complete if the case file contains no vernacular document, portion or line, or the translation is already filed at another page of the case file.
defects.location_source:
Page 2, Defect List.pdf
SCR, 2013, Page 13 of the PDF      2024011691-1.pdf
defects.ai_note:
Vernacular content appears as Hindi or other regional-language script inside an Annexure, sometimes only as a single line, stamp or endorsement, or as garbled characters where OCR fails on such script. A translation is usually headed "TRUE TRANSLATION", "TRUE ENGLISH TRANSLATION" or "TRANSLATED COPY" and carries the same Annexure number. Labels may be wrong; identify each Annexure by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) identifying any vernacular document, portion or line and (b) a translation filed for each one.
Do not treat an Index or List of Dates line describing a translated copy as the translation itself, and do not treat a typed copy of an English original as a translation.
not_applicable applies when every shown Annexure is wholly in English. Return defect_found only when a shown Annexure contains vernacular content and its shown pages, including those that follow it, carry no translation of it; quote the vernacular heading or line. Return compliant when every shown vernacular document, portion or line has a translation. Return needs_review when the vernacular content or its translation is illegible, or only part of a vernacular Annexure and its pages was shown.

defects.defect: Official Translation is not filed. An application for exemption from filing the official translation, with affidavit and court fee, also not filed
defects.requirement: Where any document or sentence is in a vernacular language, the Annexures must include an official translation of it. Failing that, an application for exemption from filing the official translation must be filed, with its supporting affidavit and court-fee proof.
defects.trigger_words: OFFICIAL TRANSLATION; Official Translator; exemption from filing; TRUE TRANSLATION; Translated by; vernacular
where_to_look: Annexures: official translation of each vernacular document
Translations headed "OFFICIAL TRANSLATION" or marked as official, and the vernacular original each one renders.
Where the translation is not official, an application seeking exemption from filing the official translation, with its supporting affidavit and court-fee proof.
The exemption application bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title and naming the vernacular Annexures it covers.
how_to_cure: Option for the User to upload the Application for Exemption from Filing Official Translation, with the court fee paid.
Option for the User to upload the supporting affidavit to the Application for Exemption from Filing Official Translation, duly sworn.

Option for the User to mark this defect as complete if no vernacular document is filed, the official translation is already filed, or the exemption application with its affidavit and court fee is already filed at another page of the case file.
defects.location_source: Page 2, Defect List.pdf
defects.ai_note:
An official translation is usually headed "OFFICIAL TRANSLATION" or marked as official; a private translation often reads "TRUE TRANSLATION" or "Translated by". The exemption application usually seeks exemption from filing the official translation of the vernacular documents and comes with a supporting affidavit and court-fee proof. Labels may be wrong; identify each Annexure and application by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) identifying vernacular content in the Annexures, (b) an official translation of it or, failing that, (c) an application for exemption from filing the official translation with its supporting affidavit and court-fee proof.
Do not treat a translation by the advocate or a private translator as official, and do not treat an application for condonation of delay or other relief as the exemption application.
not_applicable applies when every shown Annexure is wholly in English. Return defect_found only when the excerpts positively show vernacular content without an official translation and show the exemption application package with a component missing; name the failed prerequisite and component and quote its line. Return compliant when shown vernacular content has an official translation, or a complete exemption package is shown. Return needs_review when the translation or the exemption package is not in the excerpts, is illegible, or only part of the package was shown.

defects.defect: Application for permission to appear not filed by the Power of Attorney holder
defects.requirement: Where a Power of Attorney holder acts for a litigant in the matter, as shown in the Vakalatnama, the Affidavit or paragraphs 1 to 3 of the Main Petition, the Power of Attorney holder must file an application for permission to appear.
defects.trigger_words: Power of Attorney; Attorney holder; GPA holder; through his attorney; permission to appear; General Power of Attorney
where_to_look: Vakalatnama: whether executed by a Power of Attorney holder
Affidavit: whether sworn by a Power of Attorney holder
Paragraphs 1 to 3 of the Main Petition and the Memo of Parties, where a litigant is described as acting "through his Power of Attorney holder".
Where a Power of Attorney holder acts, an application by that holder seeking permission to appear, bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title.
The Power of Attorney deed naming the holder and the litigant who granted it.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for Jubeex to draft the Application for Permission to Appear by the Power of Attorney Holder.
2. Option for the User to upload the duly completed application with Jubeex.
3. Re-upload the petition along with the application.
defects.location_source: Page 3, Defect List.pdf
defects.ai_note:
A Power of Attorney holder shows up as the executant of the Vakalatnama or the deponent of the Affidavit signing "through his/her Power of Attorney holder", "GPA holder" or "Attorney holder", or in paragraphs 1 to 3 of the Main Petition. The permission application usually seeks permission for the Power of Attorney holder to appear. Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a Power of Attorney holder acting for a litigant in this matter and (b) an application by that holder for permission to appear.
Do not treat an Advocate-on-Record appearing under a Vakalatnama as a Power of Attorney holder, and do not treat a Power of Attorney mentioned only in the facts, such as one executed for a property transaction, as one acting here.
not_applicable applies when no Power of Attorney holder acts for any litigant. Return defect_found only when a shown Vakalatnama, Affidavit or petition paragraph shows a Power of Attorney holder acting and the shown applications include none for permission to appear; quote the line showing the holder. Return compliant when such an application by the holder is shown. Return needs_review when the holder's role or the applications are not in the excerpts or are illegible.

defects.defect: The petition does not contain consecutively numbered paragraphs and pages, or is not fairly and legibly typed, lithographed, or printed on one side of standard A4 paper with the prescribed margin.
defects.requirement: Under Order XV Rule 1 of the Supreme Court Rules, 2013, every petition must have consecutively numbered paragraphs and pages and be fairly and legibly typewritten, lithographed, or printed on one side of standard A4 paper with a quarter margin, unless a later applicable direction expressly provides otherwise.
defects.trigger_words: MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH; QUESTIONS OF LAW; DECLARATION IN TERMS OF RULE; GROUNDS; PRAYER
where_to_look: Main Petition: paragraph numbers and page numbers from the opening pleading through the prayer.
Main Petition page images: legibility, A4 dimensions, quarter margin, and whether petition text is printed on one side as required by Order XV Rule 1.
Any later official direction applicable to the filing mode that expressly modifies the format.
Return needs_review when only extracted text is available and physical layout or duplex printing cannot be reliably determined.
how_to_cure: 1. Consecutive Numbering of Paragraphs
1.1 Option for Jubeex to auto-number the paragraphs consecutively.
1.2. Option for the User to edit the paragraph numbering with Jubeex.
1.3. Re-upload the petition.
2. Consecutive Numbering of Pages
2.1. Option for Jubeex to auto-number the pages consecutively.
2.2. Option for the User to edit the page numbering with Jubeex.
3. Legible Scans
3.1. Option for Jubeex to OCR and create legible, clear versions of the petition.
3.2  Re-upload the petition.
defects.location_source: SCR, 2013, Page 19 of the PDF 2024011691-1.pdf
defects.ai_note:
Paragraphs of the Main Petition are numbered "1.", "2." and so on under "MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH", the "QUESTIONS OF LAW", the "GROUNDS" (often lettered A, B, C) and the "PRAYER"; page numbers sit at the top or foot of each page. Paper size, margins and two-sided printing show in the page dimensions and visual detections. Labels may be wrong; identify the Main Petition by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) paragraphs numbered consecutively, (b) pages numbered consecutively, (c) the text fairly and legibly typed, lithographed or printed and (d) printing on both sides of standard A4 paper with a quarter margin.
Do not treat lettered grounds, sub-paragraphs or numbered prayers as breaks in the paragraph sequence, and do not use the numbering of documents reproduced from the courts below.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when shown paragraph or page numbers positively skip, repeat or restart, the shown text is illegible, or the page layout shows paper other than A4 or no quarter margin; quote the numbers or line concerned. Return compliant when the shown excerpts establish every element. Return needs_review when the numbering sequence, legibility or page layout cannot be judged from the excerpts or detections.

defects.defect: Petition is not endorsed with name of the Court appealed from, full title, SC number, AOR name/petitioner-in-person name, registered address & e-mail
defects.requirement: The Main Petition must be endorsed with the name of the Court appealed from, the full title and Supreme Court case number, and the name, registered address and e-mail address of the Advocate-on-Record or petitioner-in-person, as required by Order XV, Rule 1.
defects.trigger_words: IN THE MATTER OF; ARISING OUT OF; Filed by; Drawn & Filed by; Email; E-mail; AOR Code; Address for service
where_to_look: Main Petition: court appealed from, full title and case number
Cover Page: Advocate-on-Record's name, registered address and e-mail

The cause title below "IN THE MATTER OF" or in the Memo of Parties, the "ARISING OUT OF" line naming the Court appealed from, the case number line, and the "Filed by" block; the Vakalatnama's acceptance block for the same particulars.
Each particular must be complete and consistent across the Main Petition, Cover Page and Vakalatnama; a petitioner-in-person gives his own name, address and e-mail.

For Petitoner -in-person, you can look for endorsement in Memo of parties
