defects.ai_note:
The Court appealed from and the full title appear in the cause title below "IN THE MATTER OF" and in the "ARISING OUT OF" line; the Supreme Court case number reads "SLP (C) No. … of 20.." or similar. The name, registered address and e-mail appear in the "Filed by" block of the Main Petition or Cover Page and in the Vakalatnama's acceptance block. Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) the name of the Court appealed from, (b) the full title, (c) the Supreme Court case number, (d) the name, (e) the registered address and (f) the e-mail address of the Advocate-on-Record or petitioner-in-person.
Do not use the cause title or case number of the courts below, or an e-mail address of a court, and do not report a composite defect when only one particular is proved.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when a shown endorsement positively leaves a required particular blank or states it inconsistently between the shown documents; quote that line and name the failed particular. Return compliant when the shown excerpts establish every particular. Return needs_review when the cause title, the case number line or the Filed by block is not in the excerpts or is illegible.

defects.defect: Vakalatnama not duly executed by the petitioner(s) and/or the same is not accepted by AOR
defects.requirement: The Vakalatnama must be duly executed by the petitioner(s) and must be accepted by the Advocate-on-Record, as required by Order IV, Rule 7(a).
defects.trigger_words: do hereby appoint; identified and accepted; Accepted; Executed by; Vakalat Nama; Vakalath
where_to_look: Vakalatnama: signature of each executant and the AOR's acceptance
The executants' signatures and names after "do hereby appoint and retain", and the Advocate-on-Record's line "Satisfied, certified, identified and accepted" with signature.
A duly executed Vakalatnama bears the signature of every petitioner in this matter and the AOR's signed acceptance.
The executants compared with the parties in the Memo of Parties; the Vakalatnama bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not that of the courts below.
how_to_cure: 1. Execution of the Vakalatnama by the Petitioner(s)
1.1 Prompt the User to ensure that the Vakalatnama is duly executed by all the petitioner(s) and upload the same with Jubeex.
2. Acceptance of the Vakalatnama by the Advocate-on-Record
2.1 Prompt the User to obtain the Advocate-on-Record's acceptance on the Vakalatnama and upload the duly accepted Vakalatnama with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: SCR, 2013, Page 6 of the PDF 2024011691-1.pdf
defects.notes:
Ivan's Comment:- 

Vakalatnama:- 
1) Check Cause title - includes case number, if fresh filing case number will be blank
2) Parties Name and full address
3) Dates should not be left blank in vakalatnama
4) AOR code, name, office address and contact details needs to be included
5) Satisfied, certified, identified and accepted (this line needs to be included) Sign below this 
6) Sign of petitioner, under the sign (name of the petitioner needs to be written) because sign might not explain who the petitioner is
defects.ai_note:
The Vakalatnama (also "Vakalat Nama", "Vakalath") opens "I/We … do hereby appoint and retain …", ends with the executants' signatures and names, and carries the Advocate-on-Record's acceptance, often "Satisfied, certified, identified and accepted" or "Accepted", with signature, name and code. Labels may be wrong; identify the Vakalatnama by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) execution by every petitioner, shown by each one's signature, and (b) acceptance by the Advocate-on-Record.
Do not treat the Memo of Appearance or a Vakalatnama filed in the courts below as this Vakalatnama, and do not read the Advocate-on-Record's signature as an executant's. Signatures are often missing from OCR; check the visual detections for each signature.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when a shown Vakalatnama leaves an executant's signature or the acceptance positively blank, or omits a petitioner named in the shown array of parties; quote the executant or acceptance line. Return compliant when the shown Vakalatnama establishes both elements for every petitioner. Return needs_review when the signature block or acceptance is not in the excerpts, is illegible, or only some executants are shown.

defects.defect: Memo of Appearance is not filed
defects.requirement: The Memo of Appearance must be filed, as required by Order IV, Rule 7(a).
defects.trigger_words: Please enter my appearance; enter my appearance; The Registrar; Yours faithfully; AOR Code
where_to_look: Memo of Appearance: request to enter the AOR's appearance
The letter addressed to "The Registrar" reading "Please enter my appearance on behalf of …", signed by the Advocate-on-Record with AOR Code.
A valid memo bears this matter's Supreme Court cause title and enters the Advocate-on-Record's appearance.
The memo itself, distinct from the Vakalatnama, even where both share a page headed "Memo of Appearance & Vakalatnama".
how_to_cure: 1. Option for Jubeex to auto-generate the Memo of Appearance .
2. Option for the User to upload the Memo of Appearance with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: SCR, 2013, Page 6 of the PDF 2024011691-1.pdf
defects.ai_note:
The Memo of Appearance is a short letter to "The Registrar" reading "Please enter my appearance on behalf of …", signed by the Advocate-on-Record with name and AOR Code; it is often filed together with the Vakalatnama and may share a page with it. Labels may be wrong; identify the Memo of Appearance by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a Memo of Appearance in this matter and (b) its request entering the Advocate-on-Record's appearance.
Do not treat the Vakalatnama's acceptance line, such as "identified and accepted", as the Memo of Appearance.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when a shown page headed as a Memo of Appearance positively omits the request to enter appearance, or is for another matter; quote its heading. Return compliant when a shown Memo of Appearance for this matter enters the Advocate-on-Record's appearance. Return needs_review when the memo's text is not in the excerpts, is illegible, or only the Vakalatnama is shown.

defects.defect: The AOR has neither: (i) certified that the Vakalatnama was executed in his presence, nor (ii) Made an endorsement that he has satisfied himself about its due execution
defects.requirement: The Advocate-on-Record must, on the Vakalatnama, either certify that it was executed in his presence or make an endorsement that he has satisfied himself about its due execution, and sign it, as required by Order IV, Rule 7(b)(i).
defects.trigger_words: executed in my presence; satisfied myself; Satisfied; identified and accepted; due execution; Vakalat Nama
where_to_look: Vakalatnama: AOR's endorsement on its due execution
The Advocate-on-Record's block, such as "Executed in my presence" or "Satisfied, certified, identified and accepted", with the AOR's signature, name and code.
A valid entry either certifies execution in the AOR's presence or records that the AOR is satisfied about due execution, and is signed by the AOR.
The Vakalatnama for this matter, even when its page is labelled jointly with the Memo of Appearance.
how_to_cure: Prompt the User to obtain the Advocate-on-Record's certification that the Vakalatnama was executed in the AoR's presence, or the AoR's endorsement that they have satisfied themselves about its due execution
defects.location_source: SCR, 2013, Page 6 of the PDF 2024011691-1.pdf
defects.notes:
Ivan’s Comment: The endorsement is required only on the Vakalatnama. The Vakalatnama must contain the following endorsement:

“Satisfied, certified, identified and accepted.”

This constitutes the requisite endorsement.
defects.ai_note:
The Advocate-on-Record's endorsement sits in the acceptance block of the Vakalatnama (also "Vakalat Nama", "Vakalath"), worded as "Executed in my presence", "Satisfied, certified, identified and accepted", "I am satisfied about the due execution" or similar, followed by the AOR's signature, name and code. Labels may be wrong; identify the Vakalatnama by its own heading and cause title, even when the page is labelled with the Memo of Appearance.
Compliance needs (a) either a certification that the Vakalatnama was executed in the Advocate-on-Record's presence or an endorsement that the AOR is satisfied about its due execution, and (b) the AOR's signature on it.
Do not treat the executant's signature or the Memo of Appearance as the AOR's endorsement. Wording such as "certified, identified and accepted", signed by the AOR, is affirmative certification evidence. Signatures are often missing from OCR; check the visual detections.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when the shown acceptance block carries neither certification of execution in the AOR's presence nor satisfaction about due execution, or is unsigned; quote the block. Return compliant when the shown block carries either form, signed by the AOR. Return needs_review when the block is not in the excerpts or is illegible, or when equivalent certification is shown but the word "satisfied" is omitted.

defects.defect: The affidavit is not drawn up in the first person, not divided into paragraphs numbered consecutively, or does not state the description, occupation (if any) and true place of abode of the deponent
defects.requirement: The Affidavit must be drawn up in the first person, divided into paragraphs numbered consecutively, and must state the description, occupation (if any) and true place of abode of the deponent (Order IX, Rule 4).
defects.trigger_words: do hereby solemnly affirm; aged about; resident of; R/o; by occupation; DEPONENT
where_to_look: Affidavit: deponent's opening line and paragraph numbering
The opening line below the cause title, such as "I, … aged about …, resident of …, do hereby solemnly affirm and state as under", and the numbered paragraphs that follow it.

A valid opening speaks as "I" and gives the deponent's description (such as son, daughter or wife of), occupation where there is one, and full residential address; the paragraphs run 1, 2, 3 with no gap or repeat.
The Affidavit bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title and sworn by this deponent, not an affidavit reproduced from the record of the courts below.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for Jubeex to draft a fresh affidavit , prompt the User to get it duly sworned and provide an option for the User to upload the duly sworned affidavit.
2. Option for User to Upload/Re-upload the Affidavit after including necessary details
defects.location_source: SCR, 2013, Page 15 of the PDF 2024011691-1.pdf
defects.ai_note:
The Affidavit usually opens below the cause title with "I, <name>, S/o, D/o or W/o …, aged about …, by occupation …, resident of (R/o) …, do hereby solemnly affirm and state as under:" and continues in numbered paragraphs, often each beginning "That …", up to "DEPONENT" and the "VERIFICATION". Labels may be wrong; identify the Affidavit by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) the Affidavit drawn up in the first person, (b) its paragraphs numbered consecutively and (c) the deponent's description, occupation (if any) and true place of abode stated.
Do not treat the numbering of a passage quoted from another document, or of the Verification, as the Affidavit's own paragraph sequence. The address of the advocate or of the attesting officer is not the deponent's place of abode.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when a shown passage positively shows third-person drafting, a gap or repeat in the paragraph numbers, or an opening that leaves out the deponent's description or place of abode; quote that line. Return compliant when the shown passages establish all three elements. Return needs_review when the opening or the body is not in the excerpts or is illegible, the numbering cannot be followed in what was shown, or only the occupation is left out.

defects.defect: Affidavit contains matters beyond deponent's personal knowledge
defects.requirement: The Affidavit must be confined to such facts as the deponent is able of his own knowledge to prove (Order IX, Rule 5).
defects.trigger_words: true and correct to my knowledge; believed to be true; legal advice received; I have gone through and understood; information received; VERIFICATION
where_to_look: Affidavit: deponent's statement of the source of the facts sworn
The body paragraph such as "That I have gone through and understood the contents of the accompanying petition … true and correct to my knowledge", and the "VERIFICATION" at the foot of the Affidavit.

A valid statement swears to the facts as true to the deponent's own knowledge and treats the legal submissions as believed true on legal advice; facts sworn on what others told the deponent fall outside it.
The Affidavit bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not an affidavit reproduced from the record of the courts below.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for Jubeex to draft a fresh affidavit , prompt the User to get it duly sworned and provide an option for the User to upload the duly sworned affidavit.
2. Option for User to Upload/Re-upload the Affidavit after including necessary details
defects.location_source: SCR, 2013, Page 15 of the PDF 2024011691-1.pdf
defects.ivan_comment:
Ivan's comment :- The affidavit must contain this line 
"that the contents of above
 affidavit are true and correct to the best of my knowledge
" 
Registry is concerned about this particular line at the time of filing
defects.ai_note:
The deponent's statement usually reads "That I have gone through and understood the contents of the accompanying petition, and state that the statements of facts made therein are true and correct to my knowledge, and the legal submissions made therein are believed to be true and correct on legal advice received." The "VERIFICATION" may repeat this. Labels may be wrong; identify the Affidavit by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) the facts sworn being stated as within the deponent's own knowledge and (b) no fact being sworn that the deponent could not prove of his own knowledge.
Legal submissions stated to be believed true on legal advice are not facts and do not breach the rule. Do not mistake the petition's own paragraphs, quoted in the excerpts, for the deponent's sworn statements.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when a shown passage of the Affidavit swears to facts of the case as based on information or belief from others, or to matters plainly outside the deponent's own knowledge; quote that line. Return compliant when the shown statement and Verification confine the facts to the deponent's own knowledge. Return needs_review when the statement or the Verification is not in the excerpts or is illegible.

defects.defect: Affidavit not sworn before the appropriate authority.
defects.requirement: The Affidavit must be sworn before a Notary, an authority mentioned in section 139 of the Code, a Registrar of the Supreme Court duly authorised by the Chief Justice, or an Oath Commissioner generally or specially authorised by the Chief Justice (Order IX, Rule 7). The Affidavit must be attested at the same place where the deponent is situated.
defects.trigger_words: Solemnly affirmed before me; Sworn before me; Notary Public; Oath Commissioner; Identified by me; ATTESTED; Verified at
where_to_look: Affidavit: authority before whom it was sworn and the place
The attestation at the foot of the Affidavit, below "DEPONENT" and the "VERIFICATION", with lines such as "Solemnly affirmed before me", "Identified by me" and the attesting officer's stamp and seal.

A valid attestation names a Notary, an authority under section 139 of the Code (a Court or Magistrate, a notary appointed under the Notaries Act, 1952, or an officer appointed by a High Court or an empowered court), or a Registrar or Oath Commissioner authorised by the Chief Justice.
The place on the attesting officer's stamp compared with the deponent's place in "Verified at" or the deponent's address.
how_to_cure: Prompt the User to ensure that the affidavit is sworn before a Notary, an authority specified under Section 139 of the Code, a duly authorised Registrar of the Supreme Court, or an Oath Commissioner authorised by the Chief Justice, and upload the duly sworn affidavit with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: SCR, 2013, Page 15 of the PDF 2024011691-1.pdf
defects.notes:
Section 139 CPC, 1908 :-                                                                                                                                                                     Oath on affidavit by whom to be administered — 
(a) any Court or Magistrate, or
[(aa) any notary appointed under the Notaries Act, 1952 (53 of 1952); or]
(b) any officer or other person whom a High Court may appoint in this behalf, or
(c) any officer appointed by any other Court which the State Government has generally or specially empowered in this behalf, may administer the oath to the deponent.
defects.ai_note:
The attestation sits at the foot of the Affidavit below "DEPONENT" and the "VERIFICATION": "Solemnly affirmed before me", "Identified by me", and the attesting officer's stamp, seal and place, such as "Notary Public" or "Oath Commissioner". Stamps and seals are often missing from OCR; check the visual detections. Labels may be wrong; identify the Affidavit by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) the Affidavit sworn before a Notary, an authority under section 139 of the Code (any Court or Magistrate, a notary appointed under the Notaries Act, 1952, or an officer appointed by a High Court or by an empowered court), a Registrar of the Supreme Court authorised by the Chief Justice, or an Oath Commissioner authorised by the Chief Justice, and (b) the attestation made at the place where the deponent is situated.
Do not take the identifying advocate's line or the deponent's own signature as the attesting authority.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when the shown attestation shows an authority outside that list or a place other than the deponent's; quote the attestation line. Return compliant when the shown attestation establishes a permitted authority and a matching place. Return needs_review when the attestation is not in the excerpts, is illegible, or the deponent's place cannot be found.

defects.defect: Exhibits to affidavit not marked, initialled and dated by the authority before whom they are sworn
defects.requirement: Every Annexure to an Affidavit must be marked with the title and number of the cause, appeal or matter and must be initialled and dated by the authority before whom the Affidavit is sworn (Order IX, Rule 9).
defects.trigger_words: ANNEXURE P-1; ANNEXURE A-1; TRUE COPY; Notary Public; Oath Commissioner; Solemnly affirmed before me
where_to_look: Annexures: title and number marking, and the authority's initials and date
Affidavit: authority before whom it was sworn
The top or foot of each Annexure page, where the Annexure mark, the cause title and number, and the attesting officer's initials, date and stamp are written.
A valid Annexure carries this matter's cause title and number and the initials and date of the same authority who attested the Affidavit; compare the two.
how_to_cure: 1. Marking of Exhibits
1.1. Option for Jubeex to auto-mark each exhibit annexed to the affidavit with the title and number of the cause, appeal or matter.
1.2. Option for the User to review and edit the exhibit markings with Jubeex.
1.3. Re-upload the affidavit along with the marked exhibits.
2. Initialling and Dating of Exhibits by the Prescribed Authority

2.1. Prompt the User to ensure that each exhibit annexed to the affidavit is initialled and dated by the authority before whom the affidavit is sworn, and upload the duly initialled and dated exhibits with Jubeex.
2.2. Re-upload the affidavit along with the duly initialled and dated exhibits.
defects.location_source: SCR, 2013, Page 15 of the PDF 2024011691-1.pdf
defects.ai_note:
Each Annexure usually carries a mark such as "ANNEXURE P-1" or "Annexure A-1" with the cause title and number at the top, and the attesting officer's initials, date and stamp at the top or foot. The authority's name and stamp appear in the attestation at the foot of the Affidavit. Initials, stamps and handwritten dates are often missing from OCR; check the visual detections. Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) each Annexure marked with the title and number of the cause, appeal or matter, (b) initialled by the authority before whom the Affidavit is sworn and (c) dated by that authority.
Do not take the Advocate-on-Record's "True Copy" signature, or a stamp of the courts below on a copy, as the authority's initials.
not_applicable applies only when the excerpts show the Affidavit has no annexures. Return defect_found only when a shown Annexure page positively lacks the cause title and number, or bears no initials or date of the attesting authority; quote the Annexure mark. Return compliant when every Annexure shown has all three elements matching the Affidavit's authority. Return needs_review when the Annexures or the Affidavit's attestation are not in the excerpts, the marks are illegible, or only some Annexures were shown.

defects.defect: Affidavit has an interlineation/alteration/ erasure and the same is not initialled or rewritten in the margin by the authority before whom the affidavit is sworn
defects.requirement: No Affidavit having any interlineation, alteration or erasure shall be filed unless (a) each interlineation or alteration is initialled by the authority before whom the Affidavit is sworn, or (b) in case of erasure, the words or figures are rewritten in the margin and initialled by that authority (Order IX, Rule 10).
defects.trigger_words: Solemnly affirmed before me; Notary Public; Oath Commissioner; Verified at; DEPONENT; VERIFICATION
where_to_look: Affidavit: interlineations, alterations or erasures and their initials
The body paragraphs, the "VERIFICATION" and the date and place lines of the Affidavit, where handwritten insertions, overwriting, strike-outs or whitened figures usually appear.

A valid correction has the attesting authority's initials beside it; an erasure has the words or figures rewritten in the margin and initialled. Compare the initials with the attestation at the foot of the Affidavit.
The Affidavit bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not an affidavit reproduced from the record of the courts below.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for Jubeex to flag any interlineations, alterations or erasures in the affidavit and prompt the User to have them duly initialled by the authority before whom the affidavit is sworn.
2. Option for the User to prepare a fresh affidavit with Jubeex and upload the re-sworn affidavit.
3. Re-upload the affidavit.
defects.location_source: SCR, 2013 , Page 15 of the PDF 2024011691-1.pdf
defects.ai_note:
Interlineations, overwriting, struck-out words and whitened or erased figures are usually handwritten in the Affidavit's body, its "VERIFICATION" or its date and place lines, with initials beside them or in the margin. The authority's identity appears in the attestation ("Solemnly affirmed before me", "Notary Public", "Oath Commissioner"). Handwriting, initials and stamps are often missing from OCR; check the visual detections. Labels may be wrong; identify the Affidavit by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) every interlineation or alteration initialled by the authority before whom the Affidavit is sworn and (b) every erasure rewritten in the margin and initialled by that authority.
Do not treat the deponent's own initials or the Advocate-on-Record's signature as the authority's initials. Clean typed text with no handwritten change is not an alteration.
not_applicable applies when the Affidavit pages shown carry no interlineation, alteration or erasure at all. Return defect_found only when a shown passage or visual detection positively shows such a change without the authority's initials, or an erasure not rewritten in the margin; quote the affected line. Return compliant when every change shown is initialled as required. Return needs_review when the Affidavit is not in the excerpts, the handwriting is illegible, or only part of its pages was shown.

defects.defect: Document filed is not clear, sharp and legible and is not accompanied by clearly typed/ written copy certified as true copy by AOR or party-in-person
defects.requirement: Every document filed, including each Annexure, must have clear, sharp and legible print or impression. Where an original or certified copy is of dim impression, it must be accompanied by a clearly typed or written copy certified as a true copy by the Advocate-on-Record or the litigant appearing in person.
defects.trigger_words: TRUE TYPED COPY; TYPED COPY; TRUE COPY; Certified to be true copy; ANNEXURE P-1
where_to_look: Annexures: legibility of each page and any typed copy
Each Annexure page, especially handwritten orders, faint scans and pages with cut edges, and any page headed "TRUE TYPED COPY" or "TYPED COPY".
A dim or illegible page must be accompanied by a clearly typed or written copy marked "True Copy" and signed by the Advocate-on-Record or the litigant appearing in person.
The typed copy must reproduce the same document as the dim page, matched by its date, court and heading.
how_to_cure: 1. Legible Scans
1.1. Option for Jubeex to OCR and create legible, clear versions of the document.
1.2  Re-upload the document.

2.  Prompt the User to upload a clearly typed or written copy of the original or certified document, certified as a true copy by the Advocate-on-Record or the party-in-person, where the original or certified copy is of dim impression.
defects.location_source: Circulars dt. 13.3.2000 & 27.9.2001, Page 198 of the PDF 2024042371.pdf
defects.ivan_comment: Ivan's comment:- OCR is not a requirement in SC, if there is any doubts regarding legibility, file a typed copy of instead
defects.ai_note:
Typed copies are usually headed "TRUE TYPED COPY" or "TYPED COPY" and end with "True Copy" or "Certified to be true copy" and a signature. Dim originals are often handwritten orders or faint scans whose text comes out garbled or empty; check the visual detections for legibility. Labels may be wrong; identify each Annexure by its own heading and mark.
Compliance needs (a) every document filed being clear, sharp and legible, (b) where an original or certified copy is of dim impression, a clearly typed or written copy accompanying it and (c) that copy certified as a true copy by the Advocate-on-Record or the litigant appearing in person.
Do not treat a typed copy as the dim original, or a stamp printed over clear text as dim impression.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when a shown page is so dim or garbled that its contents cannot be read and the shown pages of that Annexure carry no typed copy of it, or a typed copy is shown without a true-copy certification; quote the page's heading. Return compliant when the shown documents are legible, or each dim page is matched by a certified typed copy. Return needs_review when legibility cannot be judged from the text and visual detections, or only some Annexures were shown.

defects.defect: Annexures filed by petitioner/appellant not marked P-1, P-2, P-3 etc.; by Respondent No. 1 not marked as R-I/1, 2, 3; by Respondent No. 2 not marked as R-II/1, 2, 3; and so on
defects.requirement: Annexures filed by the petitioner or appellant must be marked P-1, P-2, P-3 etc. or A-1, A-2, A-3 etc.; Annexures filed by Respondent No. 1 must be marked R-I/1, 2, 3, by Respondent No. 2 R-II/1, 2, 3, and so on.
defects.trigger_words: ANNEXURE P-1; ANNEXURE P-2; ANNEXURE A-1; ANNEXURE R-I/1; Annexure-P1; TRUE COPY
where_to_look: Annexures: mark on the first page of each Annexure
Main Petition: Annexure marks cited in its paragraphs
The mark at the top of the first page of each Annexure, such as "ANNEXURE P-1", and the same marks cited in the List of Dates and the petition's paragraphs.
A valid mark for the petitioner or appellant runs P-1, P-2, P-3 or A-1, A-2, A-3; for Respondent No. 1 R-I/1, R-I/2; for Respondent No. 2 R-II/1, R-II/2; and so on, matching the marks cited.
The filer of each Annexure, identified before its prefix is judged; an application's own A1, A2 numbering is not an Annexure mark.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for Jubeex to auto-mark the annexures in the prescribed format (e.g., P-1, P-2, P-3 for the petitioner/appellant; R-I/1, R-I/2 for Respondent No. 1; R-II/1, R-II/2 for Respondent No. 2, and so on).
2. Option for the User to edit the annexure markings with Jubeex.
3. Re-upload the correctly marked annexures.
defects.location_source: Circular dt. 19.9.1997, Page 187 of the PDF 2024042371.pdf
defects.ivan_comment: Additional comment Ivan:- Applications are marked as A1,A2. etc.
defects.ai_note:
The mark usually stands at the top of an Annexure's first page as "ANNEXURE P-1", "Annexure-P1", "ANNEXURE A-1" or "ANNEXURE R-I/1", and the same marks are cited in the List of Dates and in the Main Petition's paragraphs. OCR may read "P-I" for "P-1". Labels may be wrong; identify each Annexure by its own heading and mark.
Compliance needs (a) each petitioner or appellant Annexure marked P-1, P-2, P-3 etc. or A-1, A-2, A-3 etc. and (b) each respondent Annexure marked R-I/1, 2, 3 for Respondent No. 1, R-II/1, 2, 3 for Respondent No. 2, and so on.
Identify who filed each Annexure before judging its prefix. Applications may use A1, A2 and must not be treated as Annexures. A generic label such as "ANNEXURE 1" is a defect only when that page is positively identified as a petitioner or appellant Annexure.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when a shown first page of an Annexure, positively identified by its filer, bears a mark outside the prescribed series; quote the actual mark and the expected one. Return compliant when every Annexure mark shown follows the prescribed series. Return needs_review when the first pages of the Annexures are not in the excerpts, the filer cannot be identified, the mark is illegible, or only some Annexures were shown.

defects.defect: Petition fails to contain the date of drafting, Date of drafting may be of the same or prior date of filing
defects.requirement: The Main Petition must contain its date of drafting, and that date must be the same as or earlier than the date of filing.
defects.trigger_words: DRAWN ON; FILED ON; Drawn & Filed by; DRAWN BY; FILED BY; New Delhi
where_to_look: Main Petition: date of drafting below the prayer
The date beside "DRAWN ON", "FILED ON", "Dated" or equivalent wording below the prayer or in the Advocate-on-Record's filing block, usually with the place such as "New Delhi".
A valid entry is a complete date; compare it with a separately shown date of filing, which it must equal or precede.
The Main Petition bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not a petition of the courts below reproduced in the record.
Supreme Court Registry filing/refiling history or the relevant Registry order: use authoritative presentation dates and any period actually allowed; do not use a drafting date as proof of filing.
Return needs_review when the governing period or an authoritative date required for the calculation is unavailable.
how_to_cure: 1. Prompt the User to provide or confirm the date of drafting of the petition. Where the petition is drafted using Jubeex, auto-fill the date of drafting.
2. Option for the User to review and edit the date of drafting with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: Circular dt. 28.5.1999, Page 195-196 of the pdf 2024042371.pdf
defects.ai_note:
The date of drafting sits at the end of the Main Petition, below the prayer or beside the Advocate-on-Record's filing block, labelled "DRAWN ON", "FILED ON", "Drawn & Filed by", "Dated" or equivalent, often with "New Delhi". Judge the date value, not whether the label literally says drafting date. Labels may be wrong; identify the Main Petition by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a date of drafting stated in the Main Petition and (b) that date being the same as or earlier than the date of filing.
A valid date beside FILED ON, DRAWN ON, DATED or equivalent wording satisfies the presence requirement and is the petition date baseline. Do not use the date of an order, event or letter mentioned in the petition's body. Handwritten dates are often missing from OCR; check the visual detections.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when the shown end of the Main Petition carries the date label with the date left blank, or its date is later than a separately shown filing date; quote the label and date. Return compliant when a valid date is shown and no shown filing date is earlier than it. Return needs_review when the end of the Main Petition is not in the excerpts or its date is illegible.

defects.defect: Affidavit enclosed with Petition is not of the same or subsequent date of the drafting of the petition
defects.requirement: The Affidavit enclosed with the Main Petition must bear a date that is the same as, or later than, the date of drafting of the petition shown below the prayer.
defects.trigger_words: Verified at; on this the; Solemnly affirmed; DRAWN ON; FILED ON; Drawn & Filed by
where_to_look: Affidavit: date of swearing or verification
Main Petition: date of drafting below the prayer
The Affidavit's "VERIFICATION" line "Verified at … on this the … day of …" and its attestation date, and the "DRAWN ON" or "FILED ON" line below the prayer.
The Affidavit's date must equal or follow the drafting date; the Affidavit's body may also state the petition's date, number of paragraphs and number of pages, which ties it to this petition.
Supreme Court Registry filing/refiling history or the relevant Registry order: use authoritative presentation dates and any period actually allowed; do not use a drafting date as proof of filing.
Return needs_review when the governing period or an authoritative date required for the calculation is unavailable.
how_to_cure: 1. Prompt the User to provide or confirm the date of drafting of the petition. Where the petition is drafted using Jubeex, auto-fill the date of drafting.
2. Option for the User to review and edit the date of drafting with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: Circular dt. 28.5.1999, Page 195-196 of the pdf 2024042371.pdf
defects.ai_note:
The Affidavit's date usually appears in its "VERIFICATION" as "Verified at … on this the … day of …" and in the attestation below "Solemnly affirmed before me". The drafting date sits below the prayer of the Main Petition as "DRAWN ON", "FILED ON" or "Drawn & Filed by". Handwritten dates are often missing from OCR; check the visual detections. Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) the Affidavit's date, (b) the petition's date of drafting and (c) the first being the same as or later than the second.
Do not use the date of an order or event quoted in either document, or an affidavit reproduced from the courts below. The petition's date recited in the Affidavit's body may confirm the drafting date but is not the Affidavit's own date.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when both dates are legible and the Affidavit is dated before the date of drafting; quote the Affidavit's date line. Return compliant when both dates are legible and the Affidavit's date is the same or later; quote its date line. Return needs_review when either document is not in the excerpts, or either date is blank or illegible.

defects.defect: Vakalatnama dated later than the date of drafting of the petition
defects.requirement: The Vakalatnama must not be dated later than the date of drafting of the petition, which appears below the prayer of the Main Petition.
defects.trigger_words: Vakalat Nama; Vakalath; Executed on; Dated this; DRAWN ON; FILED ON
where_to_look: Vakalatnama: date on which the executant signed it
Main Petition: drafting date below the prayer
The executant's date line on the Vakalatnama, such as "Dated this … day of …" or "Executed on", and the "DRAWN ON" or "FILED ON" line closing the Main Petition.
A Vakalatnama dated on or before the drafting date is in order; one dated after it is the defect. Use the Vakalatnama carrying this matter's Supreme Court cause title.
Supreme Court Registry filing/refiling history or the relevant Registry order: use authoritative presentation dates and any period actually allowed; do not use a drafting date as proof of filing.
Return needs_review when the governing period or an authoritative date required for the calculation is unavailable.
how_to_cure: 1. Prompt the User to provide or confirm the date of drafting of the petition. Where the petition is drafted using Jubeex, auto-fill the date of drafting.
2. Option for the User to review and edit the date of drafting with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: Circular dt. 28.5.1999, Page 195-196 of the pdf 2024042371.pdf
defects.ai_note:
The executant's date on the Vakalatnama (also "Vakalat Nama", "Vakalath") is usually written near the executant's signature as "Dated this … day of …" or "Executed on"; the Advocate-on-Record's "Accepted" line carries a separate date. The drafting date closes the Main Petition below the prayer as "DRAWN ON", "FILED ON" or "Drawn & Filed by". Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) the Vakalatnama's date of execution, (b) the petition's drafting date and (c) the first not being later than the second.
Do not read the acceptance date or the Memo of Appearance date as the date of execution, and do not use a Vakalatnama filed in the courts below. Handwritten dates are often missing from OCR; check the visual detections.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when both dates are legible and the execution date falls after the drafting date; quote the Vakalatnama's date line. Return compliant when both dates are legible and the execution date is on or before the drafting date. Return needs_review when either document is not in the excerpts, either date is blank or illegible, or only the acceptance date appears.

defects.defect: Paper Book/Case File not having one common index, and/or not having pagination as per format
defects.requirement: The Paper Book/Case File must have one common index together with pagination as per format.
defects.trigger_words: Particulars of Documents; part to which it belongs; Remarks; S.No.; Sl. No.; Page No.
where_to_look: Index: single common index and its page references
The Index table with columns such as "S.No.", "Particulars of Documents", "Page No. of part to which it belongs" and "Remarks".
A valid Index is one common index listing every document of the Paper Book with page numbers; the running page numbers on the documents should match the Index entries.
The Index bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not an index reproduced from the record of the courts below.
how_to_cure: 1. Common Index
1.1. Option for Jubeex to auto-generate the common index in the prescribed format.
1.2. Option for the User to upload the common index with Jubeex.
2. Pagination
2.1. Option for Jubeex to apply running pagination to the Paper Book/Case File and automatically update the page references in the common index.
2.2. Option for the User to add and edit the pagination and corresponding page references with Jubeex.
2.3. Re-upload the Paper Book/Case File.
defects.location_source: F. No. 172/Judl./2017 ( Format Attached herein) circular_02.06.2017.pdf
defects.ai_note:
The Index is a table; each row is printed as "Column header: value", with headers such as "S.No.", "Particulars of Documents", "Page No. of part to which it belongs" and "Remarks", often grouped into Part I and Part II. A blank cell is not printed in the row: a row that lists its other fields but no page number shows that the page number was left blank. Labels may be wrong; identify the Index by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) one common index for the Paper Book/Case File and (b) pagination as per format, with page numbers against its entries.
Part I and Part II of one Index are not separate indexes. Do not count an index reproduced from the record of the courts below, or a list of contents inside a single document, as a second index.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when the shown pages positively show more than one separate index for the same Paper Book, or Index entries with no page numbers; quote the affected row. Return compliant when the shown Index is one common index with page numbers against every entry. Return needs_review when the Index is not in the excerpts, is illegible, or only part of it was shown.

defects.defect: Caste or religion of parties mentioned in the memo of parties of a petition/proceeding
defects.requirement: The memo of parties in the Main Petition must not mention the caste or religion of any party.
defects.trigger_words: IN THE MATTER OF; MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH; The Humble Appeal; S/o; W/o; R/o
where_to_look: Main Petition: party descriptions in the memo of parties
The memo of parties below "IN THE MATTER OF", up to "The Humble Appeal of the Appellant Named Above" or "MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH".
Each party's name, parentage, description and address, where a caste or religion may be stated, such as "by caste …", "caste: …" or "religion: …".
The memo of parties carrying this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not a cause title quoted from the courts below.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for Jubeex to identify any reference to the caste or religion of the parties in the Memo of Parties, prompt the User to review the same, and provide an option to remove such references.
2. Option for the User to remove or edit the references to caste or religion with Jubeex.
3. Re-upload  the revised Memo of Parties.
defects.location_source:
2024021053.pdf F.No. 3/Judl./2024

"Shama Sharma versus Kishan Kumar (Transfer Petition (C) No.1957 of
2023) - The source highlights the relevant paragraphs of the case, please refer for understanding"
defects.ai_note:
The memo of parties sits below "IN THE MATTER OF" and runs up to "The Hon'ble Chief Justice of India and His Hon'ble Companion Judges …", "The Humble Appeal of the Appellant Named Above" or "MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH". Each party appears with name, "S/o", "D/o" or "W/o", age, occupation and "R/o" address. Labels may be wrong; identify the memo of parties by its heading and Supreme Court cause title.
Compliance needs (a) no mention of the caste of any party and (b) no mention of the religion of any party in the memo of parties.
A surname alone is not a mention of caste; look for express words such as "caste", "by caste", "religion" or "by religion", or a caste or religious community stated as a description. A cause title quoted from the courts below inside the petition is not this petition's memo of parties.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when a shown memo of parties entry states a party's caste or religion; quote that entry. Return compliant when the shown memo of parties covers all parties and no entry states caste or religion. Return needs_review when the memo of parties is not in the excerpts, is illegible, or only some parties were shown.

defects.defect: A filer-created document governed by Supreme Court Circular F.No.01/Judl./2020 does not use the font size or line spacing prescribed by that circular.
defects.requirement: Where Supreme Court Circular F.No.01/Judl./2020 applies to the filing mode and document class, filer-created documents other than annexures must use Times New Roman 14-point type with one-and-a-half line spacing, and quotations or indents must use 12-point type with single spacing. First establish the circular's scope and reconcile it with Order VIII Rule 1; do not apply this check to annexures or outside that scope.
defects.trigger_words: MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH; PRAYER; GROUNDS; QUESTIONS OF LAW; IN THE MATTER OF
where_to_look: Filing mode and document class: confirm that Circular F.No.01/Judl./2020 governs the document.
Main Petition and other filer-created documents, excluding Annexures: embedded font metadata where reliable and visual measurements of body text, quotations, indents, and spacing.
Order VIII Rule 1 and any later applicable formatting direction: resolve priority before reporting a defect.
Return needs_review when font metadata, reliable visual measurement, or the circular's applicability is unavailable.
how_to_cure: 1. Font Style and Font Size
1.1. Option for Jubeex to auto-format the document in Times New Roman, with font size 14 for the main text and font size 12 for quotations and indented text.
1. 2. Option for the User to edit the font style and font size with Jubeex.
2. Line Spacing
2.1. Option for Jubeex to auto-format the document in one and a half line spacing, with single line spacing for quotations and indented text.
2.2. Option for the User to edit the line spacing with Jubeex.
defects.applicable_rule: Supreme Court Circular F.No.01/Judl./2020 dated 12 March 2020; compare Order VIII Rule 1, Supreme Court Rules, 2013
defects.location_source: F.No.01/Judl./2020 12032020_071455.pdf Page 1 of the PDF
defects.ivan_comment: FONT IS NOT A MAJOR DEFECT THAT IS FLAGGED; JUST ENSURE IT IS PROPERLY LEGIBLE
defects.ai_note:
Font face, size and line spacing are layout features read from the visual detections and any font or spacing details given with the excerpts, not from the words. Body text sits under "MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH", "GROUNDS" and "PRAYER"; quotations appear as indented blocks. Labels may be wrong; identify the Main Petition by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) Times New Roman, (b) font size 14 in one and half line spacing for the body text and (c) font size 12 in single line spacing for quotations and indents.
Do not judge Annexures or any document reproduced from the record of the courts below, since they are excluded. A heading set in bold or capitals is not a font breach.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when the visual detections or font details positively show a different font face, size or spacing in the body text or the quotations; quote the affected heading or line. Return compliant when they establish all three elements. Return needs_review when the font face, size or spacing cannot be determined from the excerpts and detections.

defects.defect: Margin of 4 cm on left & right and 2 cm on top & bottom not used for filing
defects.requirement: The Main Petition, Synopsis and other filing documents, except Annexures, must use a margin of 4 cm on the left and right and 2 cm on the top and bottom.
defects.trigger_words: MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH; PRAYER; GROUNDS; IN THE MATTER OF; Dates; Events
where_to_look: Main Petition: left, right, top and bottom margins
Synopsis: left, right, top and bottom margins
The white space around the text block on full text pages, such as the paragraphs under "MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH" and "GROUNDS", the Synopsis text, and any Application drafted for this filing.
A valid page leaves 4 cm on the left and right and 2 cm on the top and bottom; Annexures are excluded.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for Jubeex to auto-format the document with 4 cm left and right margins and 2 cm top and bottom margins.
2. Option for the User to edit the page margins with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: F.No.01/Judl./2020 12032020_071455.pdf Page 1 of the PDF
defects.ai_note:
Margins are a page-layout feature read from the visual detections and any page geometry given with the excerpts, not from the words. Judge them on full text pages of the Main Petition, the Synopsis and List of Dates, and any Application drafted for this filing. Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a margin of 4 cm on the left and right and (b) a margin of 2 cm on the top and bottom.
Do not judge Annexures or any document reproduced from the record of the courts below, since they are excluded. Page numbers and signatures placed in the margin are not part of the text block.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when the visual detections or page geometry positively show a margin narrower than prescribed on a drafted page; name the document and heading of that page. Return compliant when they establish both margins on the pages shown. Return needs_review when the margins cannot be measured from the excerpts and detections, or only some of the drafted documents were shown.

defects.defect: A common index has not been placed in the first volume in case there are more than one volume in a matter and a separate index of each volume is not placed in the respective volume(s).
defects.requirement: Where a matter runs into more than one volume, a common index must be placed in the first volume and a separate index of each volume must be placed in the respective volume.
defects.trigger_words: VOLUME I; VOLUME II; VOL. I; Vol-II; Particulars of Documents; Page No.
where_to_look: Index: volume divisions and the common index
The Index heading and its "VOLUME I", "VOLUME II" entries with page ranges, and any separate Index headed with a later volume's number.
A valid set is one common Index in Volume I covering all volumes, and in each later volume a separate Index covering that volume's documents.
The Index bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not an index reproduced from the record of the courts below.
how_to_cure: 1. Common Index in the First Volume
1.1. Option for Jubeex to auto-generate the common index for all volumes and place it in the first volume.
1.2. Option for the User to upload the common index with Jubeex.
2. Separate Index for Each Volume
2.1. Option for Jubeex to auto-generate a separate index for each volume of the Paper Book/Case File.
2.2. Option for the User toupload the index of each volume with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: F.No.01/Judl./2020 12032020_071455.pdf Page 2 of the PDF
defects.ivan_comment:
There is no requirement, but as standard of practice we split after 300 pages - Ivan's comment.

[THIS HAS SORT OF BECOME REDUNDANT AFTER E-FILING BUT STILL HAVE IT AS ADVISORY]

We Split for convinence of the Judges, there is no strict rule for the same
defects.ai_note:
The Index is a table, each row printed as "Column header: value" under headers such as "S.No.", "Particulars of Documents" and "Page No."; volume divisions appear as "VOLUME I", "VOLUME II", "Vol. I" or "Vol-II" with page ranges. A separate volume Index usually repeats the cause title with its volume number. Labels may be wrong; identify each Index by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a common index in the first volume covering all volumes and (b) a separate index of each volume placed in that volume.
Do not mistake Part I and Part II of a single Index for volumes, and do not count an index reproduced from the record of the courts below.
not_applicable applies when the shown Index establishes that the matter is in a single volume. Return defect_found only when the shown pages establish more than one volume and show the first volume's Index covering only that volume, or a later volume's opening pages with no Index of its own; quote the volume heading. Return compliant when the shown pages establish both elements. Return needs_review when the volume divisions are unclear, an Index is not in the excerpts or is illegible, or only some volumes were shown.

defects.defect: A petition or application in the original set lacks the signature required at its prescribed execution place.
defects.requirement: Verify that the petition and applications in the original set bear the signatures required by the current Supreme Court Rules, forms, and Revised Checklist at their prescribed execution places. Digital signing is not mandatory for e-filing under the Supreme Court e-Filing 3.0 FAQ. Do not require Adobe Sign or a signature on every annexure unless a current document-specific direction expressly requires it.
defects.trigger_words: Digitally signed by; Signature Not Verified; Adobe Sign; FILED BY; Drawn & Filed by; Advocate-on-Record; Code No.
where_to_look: Main Petition: prescribed signature or execution block in the complete original-set petition.
Each Application: its prescribed signature or execution block in the original set.
Visual page evidence: handwritten, electronic, or digital signature actually present at the required place; do not rely on OCR alone.
Current form or document-specific direction before extending the check to a declaration, checklist, proforma, certificate, memo, Vakalatnama, or Annexure.
Return needs_review when the filing-set identity, complete signature page, or applicable form is unavailable.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for User to allow Jubeex to Auto-fill saved signature at relevant places as specified - After user approval
2. Option for the User to re-upload the Petiton.
defects.applicable_rule: Supreme Court Revised Checklist dated 9 January 2025, Registry item 2; Supreme Court e-Filing 3.0 FAQ, question 13
defects.location_source: Supreme Court Revised Checklist dated 9 January 2025, Registry item 2; Supreme Court e-Filing 3.0 FAQ, question 13
defects.ai_note:
A digital signature usually appears as a block reading "Digitally signed by <name>" with date and reason, or "Signature Not Verified", near the Advocate-on-Record's name, code and "FILED BY" line. Signatures are often missing from OCR; check the visual detections for signature blocks. Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs the digital signature of the Advocate-on-Record or the litigant appearing in person (a) on each page of the Main Petition at the required places, (b) on the last page of each Annexure and (c) on the Declaration, Advocate's Checklist, Listing Proforma/Proforma for First Listing, Advocate's Certificate, Application(s), Filing Memo, Memo of Parties, Vakalatnama and Memo of Appearance.
Do not take the executant's signature on the Vakalatnama, or a signature of an officer of the courts below on a copy, as the Advocate-on-Record's signature.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when a shown signing place of a listed document positively lacks the digital signature in both the text and the visual detections; quote that document's heading or signing line. Return compliant when the excerpts establish the digital signature on every listed document. Return needs_review when any listed document is not in the excerpts, a signing place is illegible, or only part of the required set was shown.

defects.defect: Memo of parties not filed
defects.requirement: The Memo of Parties must be filed, giving for every party the name, parent's name and complete postal address.
defects.trigger_words: IN THE MATTER OF; MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH; The Humble Appeal; S/o; W/o; R/o; Versus
where_to_look: Memo of Parties: each party's name, parentage and address
Main Petition: party details below "IN THE MATTER OF"
The details below "IN THE MATTER OF" up to "The Humble Appeal of the Appellant Named Above" or "MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH".
A valid entry gives each party's name, "S/o", "D/o" or "W/o" parentage and complete postal address; phone number and e-mail address may be ignored.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for Jubeex to fill the Memo of Parties using the information available in the case database and the details provided by the User.
2. Option for the User to upload the duly completed Memo of Parties with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: Page 2, Defect List.pdf
defects.notes:
Memo of Parties

a) A Memo of Parties is mandatory for all fresh filings.

Complete party details must include:

Name of the party;
Parent’s name; and
Complete postal address.

Advisory: 

Email ID and phone number of the parties are mandatory for e-filing.

Note to tech :- Always suggest to the user that they should provide the email and phone numbers wherever possible for them
defects.ai_note:
The Memo of Parties usually sits below "IN THE MATTER OF" and runs up to "The Hon'ble Chief Justice of India and His Hon'ble Companion Judges …", "The Humble Appeal of the Appellant Named Above" or "MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH". Each party appears with name, "S/o", "D/o" or "W/o" parentage and "R/o" address, ending with its status in the case. Labels may be wrong; identify the Memo of Parties by its heading and Supreme Court cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a Memo of Parties filed, giving for every party (b) the name and parent's name and (c) the complete postal address.
Do not treat a short cause title on the cover or a cause title quoted from the courts below as the Memo of Parties. Phone numbers and e-mail addresses are advised for e-filing, but leaving them out is not this defect.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when a shown party entry leaves out the parent's name or gives an incomplete postal address, such as a city alone; quote that entry. Return compliant when the shown Memo of Parties gives all particulars for every party. Return needs_review when the Memo of Parties is not in the excerpts, is illegible, or only some parties were shown.

defects.defect: Cause title does not correspond to impugned judgment and names of the parties therein
defects.requirement: The cause title of the Main Petition must correspond to the impugned judgment and the names of the parties in it, in their names, order and description.
defects.trigger_words: IN THE MATTER OF; Versus; through LRs; Thr. LRs; IN THE HIGH COURT OF; CORAM
where_to_look: Main Petition: cause title and memo of parties
Impugned Order: cause title and names of the parties
The names below "IN THE MATTER OF" in the petition, and the cause title at the head of the impugned judgment above "CORAM".
Names, order and description of the parties in both, watching for spelling variations, omitted or dropped respondents, and parties described as "through LRs".
Status of each party, since the roles of petitioner and respondent may change depending on which party has challenged the impugned judgment.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for Jubeex to compare the Memo of Parties with the impugned judgment, identify any discrepancies in the names of the parties, and, upon confirmation by the User, update the Cause Title accordingly.
2. If Memo of Parties is not disclosing all the details, ask user to uplod Memo of Parties of the impugned case, then allow option to edit/auto-edit
3. Re-upload the required page.
defects.location_source: Page 2, Defect List.pdf
defects.notes:
Party Not Impleaded in the Court Below

Where a party filing the matter before the Supreme Court was not a party to the proceedings before the court below, compare the party details with the impugned judgment/order and the Memo of Parties of the challenged proceedings.

The Agent should flag this to the user and seek the user’s confirmation/approval before proceeding. The Agent should also advise the user to consider filing an application seeking permission to appear/intervene in the proceedings where it is necessary 

Ivan’s Comment: If a party died before the matter was brought before the Supreme Court, no separate substitution application is required; the legal representatives (LRs) may be directly impleaded as parties. However, if a person who was already a party in the proceedings is subsequently impleaded as a respondent before the Supreme Court and that person has died, an application for bringing the LRs on record is required.
defects.ai_note:
The petition's cause title sits below "IN THE MATTER OF" with each party's name, description and status; the impugned judgment's cause title heads its first page, usually below "IN THE HIGH COURT OF …" and above "CORAM". Legal heirs often appear as "through LRs" or "Thr. LRs". Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs the parties in the petition's cause title corresponding to those in the impugned judgment in (a) their names, (b) their order and (c) their description.
A change of a party's status between the courts is not a mismatch, since the roles depend on who challenges the impugned judgment. Do not compare against another judgment quoted in the petition, or against the short title in the Synopsis or List of Dates.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when both cause titles are shown and a party is omitted or added, spelt differently, placed out of order, or described differently beyond a change of status; quote both entries. Return compliant when both are shown and every party corresponds. Return needs_review when either cause title is not in the excerpts, is illegible, or only some of the parties were shown.

defects.defect: The petitioner fails to specify the proper department and address of the Union of India or the State Govt. on and through whom the notice is required to be served, when they are party to the case
defects.requirement: Where the Union of India or a State Government is a party, the memo of parties in the Main Petition must specify its proper department and address on and through whom notice is required to be served.
defects.trigger_words: Union of India; Through the Secretary; Ministry of; Department of; Government of; Through its Chief Secretary; IN THE MATTER OF
where_to_look: Main Petition: Union or State entry in the memo of parties
The details below "IN THE MATTER OF" up to "The Humble Appeal of the Appellant Named Above" or "MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH".
A valid entry names the Union of India or the State Government "Through the Secretary" of a specific Ministry or Department, with that office's complete address.
The memo of parties carrying this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not a cause title quoted from the courts below.
how_to_cure: 1. Prompt the User to enter the proper department and address of the Union of India or the State Government on whom notice is required to be served, and option for Jubeex to fill the Memo of Parties using the information provided.
2. Option for the User to upload the Memo of Parties with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: Page 2, Defect List.pdf
defects.ivan_comment: THESE DETAILS ARE FILLED IN ON THE E-FILING PORTAL
defects.ai_note:
Government parties usually read "Union of India, Through the Secretary, Ministry of …, Government of India, … New Delhi" or "State of …, Through its Chief Secretary / Principal Secretary, Department of …", with the office address, in the memo of parties below "IN THE MATTER OF". Labels may be wrong; identify the memo of parties by its heading and Supreme Court cause title.
Compliance needs, for every party that is the Union of India or a State Government, (a) the specific Ministry or Department on and through whom notice is to be served and (b) that office's complete address.
A bare "Union of India" or "State of …" without a department, or a department without an address, does not comply. Do not use a cause title quoted from the courts below.
not_applicable applies when the shown memo of parties establishes that no party is the Union of India or a State Government. Return defect_found only when a shown entry names the Union or a State without a department or without an address; quote that entry. Return compliant when every such entry shown has both. Return needs_review when the memo of parties is not in the excerpts, is illegible, or only some parties were shown.

defects.defect: Application for bringing LRs on record/Application for Substitution is not filed
defects.requirement: Where a party in the court below has died, an Application for bringing the LRs on record or Application for Substitution must be filed.
defects.trigger_words: since deceased; through LRs; Thr. LRs; legal representatives; APPLICATION FOR SUBSTITUTION; bringing on record
where_to_look: Main Petition: sign that a party in the court below has died
Application: application for bringing LRs on record or substitution
The party descriptions in the memo of parties and the facts of the petition, for words such as "deceased", "since deceased" or "through LRs".
The heading of each Application, such as "APPLICATION FOR SUBSTITUTION" or "APPLICATION FOR BRINGING ON RECORD THE LEGAL REPRESENTATIVES".
how_to_cure: 1. Option for Jubeex to draft the Application for Bringing Legal Representatives on Record (with an option for the User to review and edit it).
2. Option for the User to upload the duly completed application and the supporting death certificate with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: Page 2, Defect List.pdf
defects.notes: Ivan’s Comment: If a party died before the matter was brought before the Supreme Court, no separate substitution application is required; the legal representatives (LRs) may be directly impleaded as parties. where_to_look: Vakalatnama: names of the executants in the main paragraph

A valid entry names every executant in full; an empty column, "____" or a placeholder in the executant portion is blank.

The opening paragraph naming the grantor, which shows whether the Vakalatnama is given by a company, society or other body.

A valid statement names both the executant signing for self and the person on whose behalf it is also executed, such as the minor or person of unsound mind.
The Vakalatnama carrying this matter's Supreme Court cause title, its signatures read against the persons named as executants.

defects.ai_note:

Do not take a guardian's description in the cause title as the statement in the Vakalatnama. Do not treat two executants who each sign for themselves as execution for self and another. Signatures and thumb impressions are often missing from OCR; check the visual detections.
Return not_applicable when the excerpts show that each executant signs only for himself and no one signs for another. Return defect_found only when the excerpts show one signature serving two persons, such as a minor named as executant with only the guardian's signature, and no statement of execution on behalf of both; quote the signature portion. Return compliant when the shown statement establishes all three elements. Return needs_review when the executant portion is not shown, is illegible, or who signs for whom is unclear.

Annexures: copy of the power of attorney
The executant's description in the opening paragraph and below the signature on the Vakalatnama, such as "through his General Power of Attorney holder".

where_to_look: Affidavit: cause title, case number and matter type at its head
Main Petition: cause title, case number and matter type

Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when a shown Affidavit names a different court, matter type, case number or set of names from the Main Petition; quote both lines. Main Petition: statement that the Annexures are true copies
The marking at the head of each Annexure, such as "ANNEXURE P-1", with its title line "True copy of …" or a "TRUE COPY" or "CERTIFIED TRUE COPY" endorsement.
The paragraph of the Main Petition or its supporting Affidavit affirming that the Annexures are true copies of their originals, read against each numbered Annexure.

defects.ai_note:
Each Annexure carries its marking, such as "ANNEXURE P-1", and usually a title line "True copy of …" or a "TRUE COPY" endorsement. The Main Petition or its Affidavit may instead affirm that the Annexures are true copies of their originals. Labels may be wrong; identify each Annexure by its own marking and this matter's cause title.
Compliance needs (a) every Annexure referred to in the Main Petition to be a true copy, shown by its own endorsement or by a blanket affirmation in the Main Petition or Affidavit expressly covering it.
If a blanket affirmation expressly covers all numbered Annexures, do not report defect_found solely because an Annexure does not repeat the words "true copy". Whether a copy is in fact true is for the Advocate-on-Record or those filing to verify; judge only what the Annexures and the affirmation state.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when a shown Annexure has no true-copy endorsement and the shown affirmation is expressly limited so that it does not cover that Annexure; quote both. Return compliant when every shown Annexure carries a true-copy endorsement, or a shown blanket affirmation covers all numbered Annexures. Return needs_review when the Annexures or the affirmation are not shown, are illegible, or only some Annexures were shown without a blanket affirmation.

where_to_look: Annexures: date and description of each Annexure in its filed sequence
List of Dates & Events: dates of the events that refer to each Annexure
The "DATES" and "EVENTS" columns of the List of Dates, the "ANNEXURE P-1" and "ANNEXURE P-2" headings on the Annexures, and the Index lines giving each Annexure's number and description.
Each Annexure's date compared with the place the List of Dates and the Index give it; an Annexure P-3 dated earlier than Annexure P-2 breaks the order.
The Annexure referred to by number in the Main Petition, matched with the document actually filed under that number in this matter.

defects.location_source: Official source not recorded
defects.ai_note:
Legal status: Needs legal verification. This status does not prevent a compliant finding when complete, legible filing evidence affirmatively satisfies every stated element. Return compliant according to the compliance instruction below. Until a current authoritative rule, form, circular, practice direction, statute, or binding judgment confirms the obligation and its applicability, convert any otherwise defect_found outcome to needs_review. Also return needs_review when any prerequisite evidence is unavailable.
Each Annexure is headed "ANNEXURE P-1", "ANNEXURE P-2" (also "Annexure A-1", "ANNEXURE-P1"), often with "TRUE COPY". The List of Dates is a table of "DATES" and "EVENTS", an event often citing its Annexure; the Index lists each Annexure with its number. Labels may be wrong; identify each Annexure by its own heading and this matter's cause title.
Compliance needs (a) the date of each Annexure shown, (b) the place of that date in the sequence of the List of Dates and the Index and (c) the Annexures being numbered and filed in that same chronological order.
Do not take a date of an earlier event mentioned inside an Annexure as the Annexure's own date. Do not treat an Index line or a Main Petition reference that only names an Annexure as the Annexure itself.
not_applicable applies only when the matter has a single Annexure. Return defect_found when the shown Annexures or List of Dates show an Annexure numbered later but dated earlier than one before it, or an order departing from the List of Dates; quote both Annexure headings and dates. Return compliant when the shown excerpts establish that the Annexures follow the chronological sequence. Return needs_review when the List of Dates or Annexures are not in the excerpts, dates are illegible, or too few Annexures were shown.

defects.defect: Complete Listing proforma/Proforma for First Listing has not been filled in or signed or not included altogether

Columns 1 to 6 must not be blank; columns 1 to 3 and column 6 must not be marked N.A., and column 7 must not be marked N.A. in a criminal matter.
defects.trigger_words: Nature of matter; Main category classification; Sub classification; Not to be listed before; Similar disposed of matter; Criminal Matters; Registration No.
where_to_look: Listing Proforma: entries in columns 1 to 7 and the AOR's signature
The numbered fields of the proforma, from "Nature of matter" in column 1 onward, and the signature block with the Advocate-on-Record's name, registration number and date at its foot.
A valid entry is a filled value; a blank in columns 1 to 6, "N.A." in columns 1 to 3 or 6, or "N.A." in column 7 of a criminal matter is a defect.
The proforma bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not a proforma of another matter.
