defects.notes:
Column 7 cannot be filled as N.A for a criminal matter, 
Column 6 also cannot be filled as N.A for both civil and criminal matters
Till Column 1-6 it cannot be blank 
Nature of matter, names of the parties column 1-3 can't be left N.A

We need to train AI on what cannot be marked as N.A in Listing proforma
defects.ai_note:
The Listing Proforma (also "Proforma for First Listing", "Listing Pro-forma") is a numbered form stored as table rows. Column 1 is the nature of matter, columns 2 and 3 the names of the parties, column 7 the criminal-matter particulars; the Advocate-on-Record's signature and date close it. Labels may be wrong; identify the Listing Proforma by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) every column filled in, with no blank among columns 1 to 6, (b) no "N.A." in columns 1 to 3 or column 6, (c) no "N.A." in column 7 where the matter is criminal and (d) the Advocate-on-Record's signature with the date.
A blank cell is not printed: a row listing other fields but not a column's value shows that column was left blank. A typed name is not a signature; signatures and handwritten dates are often missing from OCR, so check the visual detections.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found when a shown column is blank or "N.A." where not allowed, or the signature block lacks a signature or date; quote that line. Return compliant when the shown excerpts establish every column as required and the signed, dated block. Return needs_review when the proforma is not in the excerpts, is illegible, or only partly shown, or the signature cannot be confirmed.
Return defect_found only when the complete, correctly identified filing part provides positive evidence of every element of this defect. Return needs_review when evidence is absent, partial, illegible, contradictory, or depends on unavailable Registry-only metadata.

defects.defect: A miscellaneous application filed in a disposed matter does not contain the required declaration on oath explaining the reason for filing the application.
defects.requirement: Where a miscellaneous Application is filed in a disposed matter (except an application under Order XII Rule 3 or Order XVI Rule 4 of the Supreme Court Rules, 2013), the applicant must specifically state on oath, by solemn affirmation, that its filing was necessitated because (a) the order passed in the main matter is executory in nature and (b) due to subsequent events or developments, the order has become impossible to implement.
defects.trigger_words: MISCELLANEOUS APPLICATION; solemnly affirm and state; disposed of; executory in nature; subsequent events; impossible to implement
where_to_look: Application: averment on why filing in the disposed matter was needed
Affidavit: solemn affirmation supporting that averment
The paragraphs of the application stating the grounds for filing, and the "solemnly affirm and state" lines of the supporting Affidavit.
A valid declaration says on oath both that the order in the main matter is executory and that subsequent events or developments have made it impossible to implement.
The application bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title and the number of the disposed main matter, and the Affidavit sworn in support of that same application.
how_to_cure: 1.  Necessary Averment in the Miscellaneous Application

1.1. Option for Jubeex to update the miscellaneous application by inserting the requisite averment stating that the application has been necessitated because the order passed in the main proceeding, being executory in nature, has become impossible to implement due to subsequent events or developments.
1.2. Option for the User to  edit the miscellaneous application with Jubeex.
1.3. Re-upload the miscellaneous application.
2.  Supporting Affidavit

2.1. Option for Jubeex to draft the affidavit containing the declaration on solemn affirmation, prompt the User to have it duly sworn, and provide an option to upload the duly sworn affidavit with Jubeex.
2.2. Option for the User to upload the affidavit with Jubeex.
defects.notes:
Order XVI Rule 4- Hearing of Appeals                                                                                             (1)  An appellant whose appeal has been dismissed for default of appearance may, within thirty days of the order, present a petition praying that the appeal may be restored and the Court may, after giving notice of such application to the respondent who has entered appearance in the appeal, restore the appeal if good and sufficient cause is shown, putting the appellant on terms as to costs or otherwise as it thinks fit, or pass such other order as the circumstances of the case and the ends of justice may require.
(2) Where an appeal is heard ex-parte and Judgment is pronounced against the respondent, he may apply to the Court to re-hear the appeal, and if he satisfies the Court that the appeal was set down ex-parte against him without notice to him or that he was prevented by sufficient cause from appearing when the appeal was called on for hearing the Court may re-hear the appeal on such terms as to costs or otherwise as it thinks fit to impose upon him.                                                                                      Order XII Rule 3- Judgments, Decrees And Orders                                                                           (3) Subject to the provisions contained in Order XLVII o f these rules, a judgment pronounced by the Court or by a majority of the Court or by a dissenting Judge in open Court shall not afterwards be altered or added to, save for the purpose of correcting a clerical or arithmetical mistake or an error arising trom any accidental slip or omission.
defects.ivan_comment:
This declaration is part of the affidavit - "executory in nature and have become impossible to be implemented because of
subsequent events or developments and to make such a declaration on solemn affirmation" 
This line is made in the affidavit
defects.ai_note:
The declaration sits in the body of the miscellaneous application, below "MOST RESPECTFULLY SHOWETH", and is sworn in the supporting Affidavit with words such as "do hereby solemnly affirm and state". The rule does not create an automatic twenty-eight-day period running from receipt of notice in every case. Report default only after the period actually fixed by the Registrar has expired, subject to Order VIII Rule 6(4).

defects.notes:
Order VIII Rule 6 (3) Where a document is found to be defective, the said document shall, after notice to the party filing the same, be placed before the Registrar. The Registrar may, by an order in writing, decline to receive the document if, in his opinion, the mandatory requirements of the rules are not satisfied. Where, however, the 
defect noticed is formal, the Registrar may allow the party to rectify the same in his presence; but, in other cases, he may require the party to obtain an order from the Court permitting the party to rectify the same and for this purpose may allow to the party concerned, such time as may be necessary but not exceeding 28 days in aggregate.
                                                                                   
Order VIII Rule 6 (4) - Where the party fails to take any steps for the removal of the defect within the time fixed for the same by the Registrar, the Registrar may, for reasons to be recorded in writing, decline to register the document.

defects.notes:
ORDER XLVII - REVIEW
                                                                                                                                                       1.The Court may review its judgment or order, but no application for review will be entertained in a civil proceeding except on the ground mentioned in Order XLVII, rule I of the Code, and in a criminal proceeding except on the ground of an error apparent on the face of the record. The application for review shall be accompanied by a certificate of the Advocate on Record certifying that it is the first application for review and is based on the grounds admissible under the Rules.                                                                                                                                              2. An application for review shall be by a petition, and shall be filed within thirty days from the date of  the judgment or order sought to be reviewed. It shall set out clearly the grounds for review.                                                                                                                                                   3. Unless otherwise ordered by the Court an application for review shall be disposed of by circulation without any oral arguments, but the petitioner may supplement his petition by additional written arguments. The Court may either dismiss the petition or direct notice to the opposite party. An application for review shall as far as practicable be circulated to the same Judge or Bench of Judges that delivered the judgment or order sought to be reviewed.                                                                                                                                                                                   4. Where on an application for review the Court reverses or modifies its former decision in the case on the 
ground of mistake of law or fact, the Court, may, if it thinks fit in the interests of justice to do so, direct the
 refund to the petitioner of the court-fee paid on the application in whole or in part, as it may think fit.                                                                                                       5. Where an application for review of any judgment and order has been made and disposed of, no further 
application for review shall be entertained in the same matter.

defects.defect: SLP is not accompanied by certified copy of judgment or order appealed from
defects.requirement: The SLP must be accompanied by a certified copy of the judgment or order appealed from, bearing the certification of the issuing court (Order XXI, Rule 4). If a certified copy is not filed, the filing must include an application seeking exemption from filing the certified copy; for this automated check, the exemption route is treated as compliant only when the same impugned judgment or order is filed as a copy bearing a "TRUE COPY" or "TRUE TYPED COPY" endorsement.
defects.trigger_words: Certified to be true copy; Date of Application; Date of Delivery; Copying Section; Examiner; Superintendent; TRUE COPY; TRUE TYPED COPY; APPLICATION FOR EXEMPTION FROM FILING CERTIFIED COPY; permission to file without certified copy
where_to_look: Impugned Order: certification of the issuing court on the copy
The endorsement "Certified to be true copy", the copying section seal and the "Date of Application" and "Date of Delivery" entries on the copy of the judgment.

A certified copy bears the issuing court's certificate with the officer's signature or seal. If that certification is absent, check for an Application whose heading and prayer seek exemption or permission from filing the certified copy of this same impugned judgment or order.
For the exemption route, verify both documents: the exemption Application and the copy of the same impugned judgment or order bearing a "TRUE COPY" or "TRUE TYPED COPY" endorsement.
The judgment whose case number, court and date the SLP names as the one appealed from, and an exemption Application bearing the same matter's cause title.

2. Option for Jubeex to draft an application for exemption from filing the certified copy of the impugned order/judgement.
3. Option for User to upload the application for exemption.
defects.location_source: SCR, 2013, Page 31 of the PDF 2024011691-1.pdf
defects.ivan_comment: Exemption from filing impugned judgement is allowed in the case of SLP, Application of Exemption should be filed
defects.ai_note:
A certified copy carries an endorsement such as "Certified to be true copy", a copying section seal and entries like "Date of Application", "Date of Delivery" or "Examiner", usually on the first or last page of the judgment. Seals and signatures are often missing from OCR; check the visual detections. An exemption request is usually headed "APPLICATION FOR EXEMPTION FROM FILING CERTIFIED COPY OF THE IMPUGNED JUDGMENT/ORDER" or seeks permission to file without the certified copy. Labels may be wrong; identify the Impugned Order and Application by their own headings, cause title, court, case number and date.
Compliance is established by either route: (a) the judgment or order appealed from bears the issuing court's certification; or (b) an Application in this matter expressly seeks exemption/permission from filing the certified copy of that same impugned judgment or order, and the filed copy of that order bears a "TRUE COPY" or "TRUE TYPED COPY" endorsement.
A "TRUE COPY" endorsement alone is not the issuing court's certification and is not sufficient without the matching exemption Application. Likewise, an exemption Application alone is not sufficient for this automated check when the filed impugned order and its true-copy endorsement are not shown. Do not use an exemption from official translation, an application from the court below, or certification on a different order.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return compliant when either the issuing court's certification is shown, or both parts of the exemption route are shown and match this impugned order; quote the certification, or quote both the true-copy endorsement and the exemption prayer. Return defect_found only when the first and last pages positively show that the impugned order is uncertified and the complete Applications evidence positively shows that no matching certified-copy exemption Application was filed, or when one of the two exemption-route documents is positively non-compliant; quote the relevant lines. Return needs_review when the first/last order pages, true-copy endorsement, exemption Application, or matching particulars are absent from the excerpts, illegible or inconclusive.
Return defect_found only when the complete, correctly identified filing parts provide positive evidence of the defect. Return needs_review when evidence is absent, partial, illegible, contradictory, or depends on unavailable Registry-only metadata.

defects.trigger_words: solemnly affirm and state; DEPONENT; VERIFICATION; true to my knowledge; Identified by; Sworn before me
where_to_look: Affidavit: averment supporting the facts stated in the SLP

The deponent's paragraph that the facts stated in the petition are true, the "VERIFICATION" and the attestation by the notary or oath commissioner at the foot of the Affidavit.

defects.trigger_words: TRUE COPY; ANNEXURE P-1; ANNEXURE A-1; Certified to be true copy; true copies of their respective originals
where_to_look: Annexures: certified copy mark or true copy mark on each Annexure
Affidavit: averment that the uncertified Annexures are true copies

The paragraph or table in the Application listing the proposed legal representatives, with labels such as "S/o", "W/o", "Aged about", "R/o" and "Relationship with the deceased".
A valid entry gives, for every legal representative, the relationship with the deceased, the address, whether minor or major, the age and the lineage.
The substitution Application under this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not the cause title of the Main Petition.
how_to_cure: 1. Prompt the User to provide the particulars of the legal representative(s), including their relationship with the deceased, address, age, whether minor or major, and lineage, and option for Jubeex to update the substitution application using the information provided.
2. Option for the User to upload the substitution application with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: Page 100 of the PDFCourt Processes Handbook.pdf
defects.ai_note:

Return compliant according to the compliance instruction below. Until a current authoritative rule, form, circular, practice direction, statute, or binding judgment confirms the obligation and its applicability, convert any otherwise defect_found outcome to needs_review. Also return needs_review when any prerequisite evidence is unavailable.
The particulars usually appear in a paragraph or table naming each legal representative, as "Smt. X, W/o late Y, aged about 45 years, R/o …", or under columns such as "Name", "Relationship", "Age" and "Address". Lineage is shown by parentage words such as "S/o", "D/o" or "W/o". In a table a blank cell is not printed, so a row that lists other fields but not the age or address shows that field was left blank. Labels may be wrong; identify the Application by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs, for every legal representative, (a) relationship with the deceased, (b) address, (c) whether minor or major, (d) age and (e) lineage.
Do not use the particulars of the deceased in place of those of the legal representatives, and do not use the cause title of the Main Petition. An age stated in years may itself show whether the person is a minor or a major.
Return not_applicable when the shown Applications show that none seeks substitution. After legal verification is completed, return defect_found only when the shown particulars of a legal representative omit one of these items; quote that entry. Return compliant when the shown particulars give every item for every legal representative. Return needs_review when the particulars are not in the excerpts, are illegible, or only some of the legal representatives were shown.

where_to_look: Annexures: death certificate of the deceased
Application: substitution application relying on the death certificate
The fields of the death certificate printed as "Name of Deceased", "Father's/Husband's Name", "Age" and "Date of Death".
A valid certificate fills all four particulars: name, parentage, age and date of death.
The death certificate for this matter's deceased, matched by name with the person the Application says has died.

defects.ai_note:

Until a current authoritative rule, form, circular, practice direction, statute, or binding judgment confirms the obligation and its applicability, convert any otherwise defect_found outcome to needs_review. A death certificate is usually a printed form issued by the Registrar of Births and Deaths, with fields such as "Name of Deceased", "Father's Name" or "Husband's Name", "Age", "Date of Death" and "Place of Death"; it may be in Hindi with an English translation. Form fields are often read as label and value pairs, and a blank field may print only its label. Labels may be wrong; identify the death certificate by its own heading and its Annexure marking.
Compliance needs (a) the name, (b) the parentage, (c) the age and (d) the date of death of the deceased, all shown on the death certificate.
Do not take these particulars from the Application's own averments or from a death certificate of a different person; the name on the certificate should match the person the Application says has died.
Return not_applicable when the shown Applications show that none seeks substitution. After legal verification is completed, return defect_found only when a shown death certificate leaves one of these particulars blank or does not give it; quote the certificate's fields. Return compliant when the shown certificate gives all four particulars legibly. Return needs_review when the death certificate is not in the excerpts, is illegible or in Hindi without a translation shown, or only part of it was shown.

Vakalatnama: executants who appoint the Advocate-on-Record

Where the applicants are the proposed legal representatives, a Vakalatnama executed by them must be on file; a single Vakalatnama for the matter is enough.
The Vakalatnama bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not one from the courts below.

The substitution Application names its applicants in the opening paragraph, often as "the legal representatives of the deceased". The Vakalatnama (also "Vakalat Nama", "Vakalath") names the executants who appoint the Advocate-on-Record. Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) who filed the substitution Application, (b) whether that applicant is the proposed legal representative of the deceased and, if so, (c) a Vakalatnama executed by that legal representative.
A single Vakalatnama is enough; a separate Vakalatnama filed with the Application is not required. Do not use a Vakalatnama executed only by the person who has died, or a Vakalatnama of the courts below.
Return not_applicable when the shown Applications show that none seeks substitution, or the shown substitution Application is filed by someone other than the proposed legal representatives. Return compliant when a shown Vakalatnama is executed by the proposed legal representatives who filed the Application. Return needs_review when the applicants or the executants are not in the excerpts, the names are illegible, or only part of the Vakalatnama was shown.

defects.requirement: Where an Application for substitution is barred by limitation, it must be accompanied, wherever applicable, by an application to set aside the abatement and an application for condonation of delay in filing the said applications.
defects.trigger_words: SETTING ASIDE ABATEMENT; set aside the abatement; CONDONATION OF DELAY; delay of; abated; within time; barred by time

Office Report on Limitation: whether the substitution is within time
The headings "APPLICATION FOR SETTING ASIDE ABATEMENT" and "APPLICATION FOR CONDONATION OF DELAY" among the Applications filed in the matter.
Where the substitution is out of time, both applications must be on file and must relate to the same deceased and the same proceeding.
The Applications under this matter's Supreme Court cause title, told apart by their own headings.

Legal status: Needs legal verification. This status does not prevent a compliant finding when complete, legible filing evidence affirmatively satisfies every stated element. Return compliant according to the compliance instruction below. The Office Report on Limitation states whether a matter is "within time" or "barred by time"; a substitution application may itself say the proceeding has "abated" and give the date of death. The companion applications are usually headed "APPLICATION FOR SETTING ASIDE ABATEMENT" and "APPLICATION FOR CONDONATION OF DELAY". Labels may be wrong; identify each Application by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) whether the substitution Application is barred by limitation and, where it is, (b) an application to set aside the abatement and (c) an application for condonation of delay in filing those applications, both for the same deceased and proceeding.
Do not treat a delay application or Office Report finding about the main petition as one about the substitution.
Return not_applicable when the shown material shows no substitution Application, or shows it is within limitation. After legal verification is completed, return defect_found only when a shown passage shows the substitution is barred and the shown text positively shows either companion application was not filed; quote the limitation line. Return compliant when the substitution is shown to be barred and both companion applications are shown. Return needs_review when the substitution's limitation is not shown, the Applications' headings are not in the excerpts, or only one companion application was shown.

defects.defect: The application for the appointment of a new next friend of a minor is not supported by an affidavit showing that the person proposed is a fit and proper person to be so appointed
defects.requirement: Where an Application is made for the appointment of a new next friend of a minor, it must be supported by an Affidavit showing that the person proposed is a fit and proper person to be so appointed (Order VII, Rule 4).
defects.trigger_words: new next friend; next friend; fit and proper person; solemnly affirm; DEPONENT; no interest adverse
where_to_look: Affidavit: statement that the proposed next friend is fit and proper
Application: appointment of a new next friend of a minor
The paragraphs of the Affidavit filed in support of the Application, introduced by "solemnly affirm and state".
A valid Affidavit is sworn in support of this Application and states that the proposed next friend is a fit and proper person to be appointed.
The Affidavit supporting the new next friend Application, not the Affidavit supporting the Main Petition.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for Jubeex to draft the affidavit in support of the application for appointment of a new next friend, stating that the proposed person is a fit and proper person to be appointed and has no interest adverse to that of the minor, prompt the User to have it duly sworn, and provide an option to upload the duly sworn affidavit with Jubeex.
2. Option for the User to upload the affidavit with Jubeex or re-upload the application with the affidavit.
defects.location_source: SCR, 2013, Page 12 of the PDF 2024011691-1.pdf
defects.ai_note:
The Application is usually headed "APPLICATION FOR APPOINTMENT OF NEW NEXT FRIEND". The supporting Affidavit begins "I, … do hereby solemnly affirm and state" and usually says the proposed person "is a fit and proper person" to be appointed. Labels may be wrong; identify the Affidavit by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) an Application for appointment of a new next friend of a minor, (b) an Affidavit in support of it and (c) a statement in that Affidavit showing that the proposed person is fit and proper to be so appointed.
Do not use the Affidavit supporting the Main Petition, or a bare averment in the Application itself, as the supporting Affidavit. An application for a guardian of a minor on the other side is a different check.
Return not_applicable when the shown Applications show that none seeks appointment of a new next friend. Return defect_found only when a shown Affidavit supports that Application but does not show the proposed person to be fit and proper; quote its operative paragraph. Return compliant when the shown supporting Affidavit says so. Return needs_review when the supporting Affidavit or its operative paragraphs are not in the excerpts, are illegible, or only part was shown.

defects.defect: Appeal/petition/proceeding by minor not instituted or continued in his name by next friend
defects.requirement: Where a minor is a petitioner or appellant, the Main Petition must show that the appeal, petition or other proceeding is instituted or continued in the minor's name by the minor's next friend (Order VII, Rule 1).
defects.trigger_words: next friend; through his next friend; through her next friend; Minor through; natural guardian; Aged about
where_to_look: Main Petition: cause title naming a minor and the next friend
The cause title under "IN THE MATTER OF" and the Memo of Parties, where a minor is described as "Minor", "aged about … years" or "through his next friend".
A valid entry names the minor as the petitioner or appellant together with "through his/her next friend" and the next friend's name.
The cause title of this matter before the Supreme Court, not a cause title of the courts below quoted in the petition.
how_to_cure: 1. Prompt the User to provide the particulars of the next friend and option for Jubeex to update the Memo of Parties to reflect that the proceeding is instituted or continued through the next friend.
2. Option for Jubeex to draft the application for appointment of a next friend.
3. Option for the User to upload the application with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: SCR, 2013, Page 11 of the PDF 2024011691-1.pdf
defects.ai_note:
The cause title or Memo of Parties describes a minor petitioner or appellant as "X (Minor), through his next friend Y" or "Minor through natural guardian", often with "aged about … years". Labels may be wrong; identify the Main Petition by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a minor among the petitioners or appellants and (b) the proceeding instituted or continued in the minor's name by the minor's next friend.
A minor shown only as a respondent does not attract this check. Do not use a cause title of the courts below; the description must appear in this Court's cause title.
Return not_applicable when the shown cause title shows no minor among the petitioners or appellants. Return defect_found only when a shown cause title names a minor petitioner or appellant without a next friend; quote that entry. Return compliant when every shown minor petitioner or appellant is described as acting through a next friend. Return needs_review when the cause title or Memo of Parties is not in the excerpts, is illegible, or it is unclear whether a party is a minor.

defects.defect: An application has not been filed for appointment of a guardian and/or the application is not supported by an affidavit stating that the proposed guardian has no interest in the matter adverse to that of the minor
defects.requirement: Where a respondent to an appeal or petition is a minor not represented by a guardian, the appellant or petitioner must file an Application for appointment of a guardian, supported by an Affidavit stating that the proposed guardian has no interest in the matter adverse to the minor (Order VII, Rule 5).
defects.trigger_words: guardian; gaurdian; appointment of guardian; no interest adverse; guardian ad litem; Minor through; Aged about
where_to_look: Main Petition: minor respondent and whether a guardian represents him
Application: appointment of a guardian for the minor respondent
The cause title under "IN THE MATTER OF" and the Memo of Parties, where a respondent is described as "Minor" or "through guardian", and the heading "APPLICATION FOR APPOINTMENT OF GUARDIAN".
Affidavit: statement that the proposed guardian has no interest adverse to the minor
The Affidavit supporting the guardian Application, not the Affidavit supporting the Main Petition.

1.1. Option for Jubeex to draft the Application for Appointment of Guardian.
1.2. Option for the User to upload the Application for Appointment of Guardian with Jubeex.

defects.location_source: SCR, 2013, Page 12 of the PDF 2024011691-1.pdf
defects.ai_note:
A minor respondent appears in the cause title or Memo of Parties as "X (Minor)", with or without "through his guardian". The Application is usually headed "APPLICATION FOR APPOINTMENT OF GUARDIAN" (OCR may read "gaurdian"); its Affidavit says the proposed guardian "has no interest in the matter adverse to that of the minor". Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a minor respondent not represented by a guardian, (b) an Application by the appellant or petitioner for appointment of a guardian and (c) a supporting Affidavit stating that the proposed guardian has no interest in the matter adverse to the minor.
A minor petitioner acting through a next friend does not attract this check. Do not use the Main Petition's Affidavit, or a statement made only in the Application.
Return not_applicable when the shown cause title shows no minor respondent, or shows one already represented by a guardian. Return defect_found only when an unrepresented minor respondent is shown and the shown guardian Application or its Affidavit omits the statement of no adverse interest; quote the operative line. Return compliant when the shown Affidavit supporting the guardian Application contains that statement. Return needs_review when the cause title, the guardian Application or its Affidavit is not in the excerpts or is illegible.

defects.defect: Cause title of the memorandum of appeal or petition does not contain the status of the parties in the court(s) below, i.e. whether they were the plaintiff, defendant, petitioner, appellant, respondent, applicant or non-applicant, etc.
defects.requirement: The cause title of the Main Petition must state, for each party, its status in the court(s) below, such as plaintiff, defendant, petitioner, appellant, respondent, applicant or non-applicant, and its status before this Court.
defects.trigger_words: IN THE MATTER OF; Versus; In the High Court; In this Court; Plaintiff; Non-Applicant
where_to_look: Main Petition: status of each party in the court(s) below
The cause title under "IN THE MATTER OF" and "Versus", where each name carries its status, often in columns such as "In the High Court" and "In this Court".
A valid entry gives every party both statuses, for example "Plaintiff/Respondent No. 1" for the court below and "Respondent No. 1" before this Court.
Impugned Order: the parties' descriptions in the court below, compared with the cause title
how_to_cure: 1. Prompt the User to specify the status of each party in the court(s) below (e.g., Plaintiff, Defendant, Petitioner, Appellant, Respondent, Applicant, Non-Applicant, etc.) with an option for Jubeex to auto-fill the cause title with the specified status of the parties.
2. Option for the User to review and edit the cause title with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: Page 61 of the PDF Court Processes Handbook.pdf
defects.notes: Also check whether the status of party before the Supreme court has been disclosed or not
defects.ivan_comment: Applicable in both, civil and criminal case
defects.ai_note:
Legal status: Needs legal verification. This status does not prevent a compliant finding when complete, legible filing evidence affirmatively satisfies every stated element. Return compliant according to the compliance instruction below. Until a current authoritative rule, form, circular, practice direction, statute, or binding judgment confirms the obligation and its applicability, convert any otherwise defect_found outcome to needs_review. Also return needs_review when any prerequisite evidence is unavailable.
The cause title of the Main Petition sits under "IN THE MATTER OF", the sides separated by "Versus"; each status often appears in columns such as "In the High Court" and "In this Court", or as "Plaintiff/Appellant" beside the name. In a table a blank cell is not printed, so a row that lists a name without a status shows the status was left blank. Labels may be wrong; identify the Main Petition by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs, for every party in the cause title, (a) its status in the court(s) below and (b) its status before this Court.
Do not use the cause title of the Impugned Order as this Court's cause title; the Impugned Order serves only to see whether the stated status matches the party's actual position below.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability; where the matter has no court below, judge only element (b). After legal verification is completed, return defect_found only when the shown cause title gives a party without its status below or before this Court, or with a status that contradicts the Impugned Order; quote that entry. Return compliant when the shown cause title gives both statuses for every party. Return needs_review when the cause title is not in the excerpts, is illegible, or only some of the parties were shown.

defects.defect: The petition fails to contain a statement in terms of Order XXI/XXII of Supreme Court Rules as to whether the petitioner has filed any petition against the impugned order/judgment earlier, and if so, the result thereof stated in the petition
defects.requirement: The Main Petition must contain a statement in terms of Order XXI/XXII of the Supreme Court Rules as to whether any petition was filed earlier against the impugned order/judgment and, if so, the result thereof.
defects.trigger_words: DECLARATION IN TERMS OF RULE 3; no other petition seeking leave; seeking leave to appeal; with what result; against the impugned judgment
where_to_look: Main Petition: statement on any earlier petition against the same order
The heading "DECLARATION IN TERMS OF RULE 3(2)", or Rule 2(2) in a criminal SLP, between the questions of law and the grounds.
A valid statement says whether any petition for special leave against the same impugned order was filed earlier and, where one was, its result.
The statement in this SLP's own text, not a narration of earlier proceedings in the courts below or in the Impugned Order.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for the User to edit the Main Petition with Jubeex.
defects.location_source: Page 2, Defect List.pdf
defects.notes: Order XXI- SLP (Civil) - Rule 3(2) -  No petition shall be entertained by the Registry unless it contains a statement as to whether the petitioner had filed any petition for special leave to appeal against the impugned Judgment or order earlier and if so, with what result, duly supported by an affidavit ofthe petitioner or his Pairokar only.                                                                      Order XXII SLP (CRL) - Rule 2(2) - No petition shall be entertained by thi Registry unless it contains a statement as to whether the petitioner had filed any petition for special leave to appeal against the impugned Judgment or order earlier, and if so, with what result, duly supported by an affidavit of the petitioner or his pairokar only.
defects.notes_2:
Ask IVAN - Where does this statement in terms of Order XXI/XXII appear in the petition filed before the  court?

Ivan's comment:- Para 2 or 3 of the main petition (usually in the introductory paragraphs)
defects.ai_note:
The statement usually sits under the heading "DECLARATION IN TERMS OF RULE 3(2)" (Order XXI, civil) or "RULE 2(2)" (Order XXII, criminal), reading for example "The petitioner states that no other petition seeking leave to appeal has been filed against the impugned judgment". The Rules also require it to be supported by an affidavit of the petitioner or his pairokar. Labels may be wrong; identify the Main Petition by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a statement whether any petition was filed earlier against the same impugned order or judgment and (b), if one was filed, the result of that petition.
Do not treat the narration of proceedings in the courts below, a review or appeal filed in the High Court, or the facts of the Impugned Order as this statement; it must speak of an earlier petition to this Court against the same order.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when the shown declaration is blank, or says an earlier petition was filed without giving its result; quote it. Return compliant when the shown statement says no earlier petition was filed, or names the earlier petition and its result. Return needs_review when the declaration is not in the excerpts or is illegible.

defects.defect: The SLP paper-book is not arranged in the sequence currently required by Order XXI Rule 3(1)(f) and the applicable Supreme Court checklist, including lower-court judgments only where the proceeding requires them.
defects.requirement: Arrange an SLP paper-book in accordance with Order XXI Rule 3(1)(f) of the Supreme Court Rules, 2013 and the current Supreme Court checklist. Do not apply the 12 January 1996 sequence as an unconditional current rule. Trial Court and First Appellate Court judgments are additionally required where the SLP challenges an order passed in second appeal or another current rule or checklist item requires them.
defects.trigger_words: Sl. No.; Particulars of Documents; Page No.; Remarks; PART-I; PART-II
where_to_look: Index and complete paper-book manifest: actual sequence and page range of every filed part.
Main Petition and Impugned Order: identify whether the challenged order was passed in second appeal and which lower-court judgments are therefore required.
Order XXI Rule 3(1)(f) and the current Supreme Court checklist: compare the sequence applicable to this SLP.
Do not require Trial Court and First Appellate Court judgments in every SLP solely because they appeared in the 1996 circular.
Return needs_review if the complete manifest, procedural history, or current governing checklist is unavailable.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for Jubeex to automatically arrange the documents in the prescribed order.
2. Option for the User to edit the document sequence with Jubeex.
( We need to ensure that we receive separate docuement and when the agent compiles it, we leave a blank page at the start)
defects.applicable_rule: Order XXI Rule 3(1)(f), Supreme Court Rules, 2013; Supreme Court Revised Checklist dated 9 January 2025, Advocate-on-Record items 3 and 11
defects.location_source: Supreme Court Rules, 2013, Order XXI Rule 3(1)(f); Supreme Court Revised Checklist dated 9 January 2025, Advocate-on-Record items 3 and 11
defects.ai_note:
The arrangement is read from the Index, where each document is listed against "Sl. No.", "Particulars of Documents" and "Page No.", sometimes in "PART-I" and "PART-II"; rising page numbers show the order in the paper-book. Labels may be wrong; identify the Index by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) the sequence of documents shown in the Index with their page numbers and (b) that sequence following the prescribed order: white blank sheet, Index, Office Report on Limitation, List of Dates, Trial Court Judgment, Appellate Court Judgment, Impugned Judgment, SLP with Affidavit and Certificate, Annexures referred to in the SLP, and Applications.
A document not filed, such as a Trial Court Judgment in a matter with none, is skipped, not counted as out of order. The Synopsis travels with the List of Dates, and an Appendix, if any, sits between the SLP and its Annexures.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when shown Index lines place a document out of the prescribed order; quote the two lines. Return compliant when the shown Index lists every filed document in that order with rising page numbers. Return needs_review when the Index is not in the excerpts, is illegible, has no page numbers, or was only partly shown.

defects.defect: The English version of the relevant provisions of the Constitution, statutes, ordinances, rules, regulations, bye laws, orders etc. referred to in the impugned judgment/ order has not been filed as Appendix to the SLP.
defects.requirement: The Appendix to the SLP must contain the English version of the relevant provisions of the Constitution, statutes, ordinances, rules, regulations, bye-laws, orders etc. referred to in the Impugned Order.
defects.trigger_words: relevant provisions; reads as under; reads as follows; Section; Article; The Constitution of India
where_to_look: Appendix: English text of each provision relied on
Impugned Order: provisions of law referred to in it
The provision numbers cited in the Impugned Order, such as a Section, Article or Rule, compared one by one with the headings of the provisions reproduced in the Appendix.
The Appendix filed with this SLP under its Supreme Court cause title, not a provision quoted inside the Impugned Order or the Main Petition.
how_to_cure: Option for the User to upload the Appendix setting out the English version of the relevant provisions referred to in the impugned judgment or order.
Option for the User to mark this defect as complete if the Appendix already sets out the English version of every relevant provision, or the impugned judgment or order refers to none.
defects.location_source: Page 4, Defect List.pdf
defects.ivan_comment: Ivan to confirm
defects.notes_2: Ivan's comment:- It is a mandate, and English translation is required & there is no exemption for this
defects.ai_note:
The Appendix reproduces each provision under its own heading, naming the Section, Rule or Article and the Act or instrument, often introduced by "reads as under". The Impugned Order refers to provisions in its reasoning as "Section …", "Rule …" or "Article …". Labels may be wrong; identify the Appendix by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) the distinct provisions actually relied on in the Impugned Order, (b) an Appendix in English and (c) the English version of each of those provisions in the Appendix.
First list the provisions the Impugned Order actually relies on, then compare that set with the Appendix. Do not treat every passing procedural citation as substantively relevant without saying why, or count a provision quoted only inside the Impugned Order or the Main Petition. A provision reproduced only in another language does not meet the rule.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when a clearly relevant provision relied on in the shown Impugned Order is not reproduced in the shown Appendix; name the exact missing provision. Return compliant when the shown Appendix reproduces in English every relevant provision relied on. Return needs_review when either document is not in the excerpts, is illegible, the Appendix was only partly shown, or a provision's relevance is ambiguous.

defects.defect: The Advocate-on-Record failed to certify that the SLP is confined only to the pleadings before the Court/Tribunal whose order is challenged and the documents relied upon therein; that no additional facts, documents or grounds have been taken or relied upon; and that the annexures are necessary to answer the question of law raised. The certificate fails to add that it is given on the basis of the petitioner's instructions
defects.requirement: The AOR's Certificate must certify that the SLP is confined only to the pleadings before the Court/Tribunal whose order is challenged and the documents relied upon therein; that no additional facts, documents or grounds have been taken or relied upon; and that the annexures are necessary to answer the question of law raised. The certificate must add that it is given on the basis of the petitioner's instructions.
defects.trigger_words: Certified that; confined only to the pleadings; no additional facts; necessary to answer the question; given on the basis of; Advocate-on-Record
where_to_look: AOR's Certificate: the certified statements and whose instructions it rests on
The paragraph beginning "Certified that the Special Leave Petition is confined only to the pleadings" and its closing line on whose instructions it is given.

A valid certificate states all four points: confined to the pleadings and documents before the court whose order is challenged; no additional facts, documents or grounds; Annexures necessary to answer the question of law; given on the petitioner's instructions.
The certificate given by the Advocate-on-Record for this SLP under its Supreme Court cause title, not the verification of the Affidavit.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for Jubeex to auto-draft the AOR's certificate  and prompt the User to get it signed, along with an option for the user to re-upload the same.
2. Option for the User to upload the AOR's Certificate with Jubeex.

defects.notes:
Ask Ivan:- Whether we have to disclose in the certificate if we seek application for filing additional documets



No, that application is separate
defects.ai_note:
The AOR's Certificate usually begins "Certified that the Special Leave Petition is confined only to the pleadings before the Court/Tribunal whose order is challenged" and ends with a line such as "This certificate is given on the basis of the instructions given by the petitioner", followed by the Advocate-on-Record's name. Labels may be wrong; identify the AOR's Certificate by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) the SLP confined to the pleadings before the Court/Tribunal whose order is challenged and the documents relied upon there, (b) no additional facts, documents or grounds taken or relied upon, (c) the Annexures necessary to answer the question of law raised and (d) a statement that the certificate is given on the basis of the petitioner's instructions.
Do not use the verification of the Affidavit or the Main Petition's own averments in place of the certificate. The certificate need not mention an application for filing additional documents, which is separate.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when the shown certificate, read in full, omits one of the four statements; quote the certificate text shown. Return compliant when the shown certificate contains all four. Return needs_review when the certificate is not in the excerpts, is illegible, or is only partly shown.

defects.trigger_words: ADDITIONAL DOCUMENTS; permission to file additional documents; additional grounds; APPLICATION FOR PERMISSION TO FILE; not part of the record; TRUE COPY
where_to_look: Annexures: documents not on the record of the court below
Application: permission to file or rely on additional documents or grounds
Impugned Order: documents and facts it refers to, compared with the Annexures and the List of Dates
An Annexure is additional when it was not before the court below, for example one dated later than the Impugned Order or described as a fresh or additional document.
The Application under this SLP's cause title headed "APPLICATION FOR PERMISSION TO FILE ADDITIONAL DOCUMENTS" or for additional grounds.

defects.location_source: Circulars dt. 6.8.1997 & 1.9.1997; Order XVI Rule 5(1)/Order XXI Rule 3(5), Page 185 of the PDF 2024042371.pdf

defects.notes_2:
Ivan's comment:- 
We will check whether there are documents additional to the documents presnented in HC and any document post the date of impugned order date

Do not treat a document referred to in the Impugned Order or forming part of the record below as additional, and do not count an application for exemption or condonation of delay as the permission Application.

Return defect_found only when a shown Annexure or ground is positively additional and the shown Application headings include no permission Application; quote the Annexure's description. where_to_look: Office Report on Limitation: legibility of its text and figures
The lines stating that the matter is "within time" or "barred by time", and the figure for the days of delay.
A legible copy reads as whole words and figures throughout; blurred, faded, cropped or broken text, or an unreadable figure for the days of delay, fails.
The Office Report under this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not a limitation statement in the body of the Main Petition.
how_to_cure: Option for the User to upload a  clear and legible copy of the Office Report on Limitation.
defects.notes: It should not be flagged if the Office Report on Limitation is not signed
defects.ai_note:
The Office Report on Limitation is a short Registry form stating that the matter is "within time" or "barred by time", with the limitation period, the days of delay and the relevant dates. A clear copy gives whole words and figures; a blurred, faded or cropped scan gives broken words, stray symbols or missing figures. Labels may be wrong; identify the Office Report on Limitation by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a copy of the Office Report on Limitation that is (b) clear and (c) legible throughout, including its figures and dates.
An unsigned Office Report is not this defect and must not be treated as one. Do not treat a single OCR slip in otherwise clean text as illegibility; check the visual detections before deciding.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when the shown text of the Office Report is blurred, garbled or cut off so that its content or figures cannot be read; quote the affected line. Return compliant when the shown Office Report reads clearly throughout. Return needs_review when the Office Report is not in the excerpts or only part of it was shown.

where_to_look: Listing Proforma: legibility of its field labels and entries
The numbered fields of the Proforma for First Listing, such as "The case pertains to", "Central Act" and "Nature of matter", with the entries filled against them.
A legible copy shows every field label and filled entry as readable words and figures; blurred, faded, cropped or broken text fails.
The Listing Proforma under this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not a similar summary inside the Main Petition.
how_to_cure: Option for the User to upload a  clear and legible copy of the Listing Proforma.
defects.ai_note:
The Listing Proforma, headed "PROFORMA FOR FIRST LISTING", is a form of numbered fields such as "The case pertains to", "Central Act", "Section", "Nature of matter" and "Caveat", with an entry against each. Fields are often read as label and value pairs; a clear copy gives readable labels and entries, while a poor scan gives broken words, stray symbols or empty values. Labels may be wrong; identify the Listing Proforma by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a copy of the Listing Proforma that is (b) clear and (c) legible in its labels and filled entries.
A field left blank because it does not apply is a question of completeness, not legibility. Do not treat one OCR slip in otherwise clean text as illegibility; check the visual detections for blurred or faded areas.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when a shown part of the Listing Proforma is blurred, garbled or cut off so that its labels or entries cannot be read; quote the affected field. Return compliant when the shown Listing Proforma reads clearly throughout. Return needs_review when the Listing Proforma is not in the excerpts or only part of it was shown.

defects.trigger_words: Dates; Events; Hence the present; Particulars of events
where_to_look: Synopsis: legibility of its narrative text
List of Dates & Events: legibility of each date and event
The "Dates" and "Events" columns, read row by row, and the narrative paragraphs of the Synopsis ending with a line such as "Hence the present petition".
A legible copy gives every date and event as readable words and figures; blurred, faded, cropped or broken text, or a date that cannot be read, fails.
The Synopsis and List of Dates under this matter's Supreme Court cause title, not the facts narrated in the Main Petition.

defects.ai_note:
The Synopsis is a short narrative of the case, and the List of Dates sets out each date against its event, often in a table with columns "Dates" and "Events", ending with a line such as "Hence the present petition". A clear copy gives readable dates and sentences; a poor scan gives broken words, stray symbols or unreadable figures. Labels may be wrong; identify the Synopsis and List of Dates by their own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a copy of the Synopsis and (b) a copy of the List of Dates, each (c) clear and legible throughout, including every date.
Whether the events are complete or the dates accurate is not this check. Do not treat one OCR slip in otherwise clean text as illegibility, and do not use the statement of facts in the Main Petition in place of these documents.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when a shown part of the Synopsis or List of Dates is blurred, garbled or cut off so that its text or dates cannot be read; quote the affected line. Return compliant when the shown Synopsis and List of Dates read clearly throughout. Return needs_review when either document is not in the excerpts or only part of it was shown.

defects.defect: Clear/legible copy of impugned judgment is not filed
defects.requirement: The copy of the impugned judgment must be filed clear and legible throughout.
defects.trigger_words: IN THE HIGH COURT OF; CORAM; MR. JUSTICE; Reserved on; Pronounced on; Counsel for the
where_to_look: Impugned Order: legibility of the judgment under challenge
The judgment's court heading and case number, its "CORAM" line, the reasoning paragraphs and the operative order with its date.
A clear copy reads as continuous text: the court, case number, date, Judges' names and reasoning can all be read without gaps or garbled characters.
The judgment under challenge in this matter, identified by its own court heading and case number, not the account of it in the Synopsis or List of Dates & Events.
how_to_cure: Option for the User to upload a clear and legible copy of the Impugned Judgment.
defects.ai_note:
The impugned judgment is the decision of the High Court or other forum under challenge. It opens with the forum's name, the case number and a "CORAM" line naming the Judge or Judges, and closes with the operative order and its date, sometimes after "Reserved on" and "Pronounced on" lines. Labels may be wrong; identify the impugned judgment by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a copy of the impugned judgment and (b) that copy being clear and legible throughout.
Do not assess legibility from the Synopsis, the List of Dates & Events or passages of the judgment quoted in the Main Petition; only the copy of the judgment itself counts. A single faint word does not make the whole copy illegible.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when shown text of the judgment is blurred, garbled, cut off or blank where its text should be, so that its content cannot be read; quote the unreadable passage. Return compliant when every shown part of the judgment reads clearly, including its court, case number, date and reasoning. Return needs_review when the judgment is not in the excerpts, or when it cannot be told whether poor text comes from the copy itself.

Affidavit: legibility of the deponent's statements and verification

Each document bearing this matter's Supreme Court cause title, readable as continuous text without blurred, blank or garbled stretches.

Labels may be wrong; identify the impugned order by its own heading and cause title.

Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when the shown pages of the impugned order are largely unreadable and none of the shown copies of that order is a typed copy; quote the garbled text. Return compliant when the shown impugned order reads clearly, or a typed copy of it is shown; quote a readable line. Return needs_review when the impugned order is not in the excerpts, or legibility cannot be judged from the text and the visual detections.

The permission request is an I.A. headed "APPLICATION FOR PERMISSION TO FILE SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION". Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a finding whether the petitioner was a party to the proceedings below and, if not, (b) an application for permission to file the petition.
Do not treat a change of name or a legal heir already on record below as a stranger. Do not treat an application for exemption or condonation of delay as the permission application.

Do not treat a statement about other proceedings, such as a writ petition or revision in another court, as this declaration, or an affidavit of another proceeding as the supporting Affidavit.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. defects.ai_note:

Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. defects.defect: SLP (Criminal) is not accompanied by certified copy of judgment/order

where_to_look: Impugned Order: copying-section certificate on the judgment/order
The certifying stamp, often "Certified to be true copy" with the Copying Section's dates and the officer's signature, on the first or last page of the impugned judgment/order.
A certified copy carries the issuing court's own certification; counsel's "TRUE COPY", a website download or a typed copy is not one.
The copy whose court, case number and date match those given in the Synopsis or paragraph 1 of the Main Petition as the judgment/order under challenge.

Labels may be wrong; identify the impugned judgment/order by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a copy of the impugned judgment/order accompanying the SLP (Criminal) and (b) that copy being a certified copy.
A copy marked "TRUE COPY" by the Advocate-on-Record, a print from the High Court website with a download footer, or a typed copy is not certified; nor is a certified copy of the trial court's judgment when the High Court's order is under challenge. Seals, stamps and signatures are often missing from OCR; check the visual detections for the copying seal.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when the shown first and last pages of the impugned judgment/order carry no certification in either the text or the visual detections, such as a page ending in a website footer; quote that footer or last line. Application: Crl.M.P. or I.A. seeking exemption from the certified copy

Counsel's "TRUE COPY" mark, a website print and a typed copy are not certification. An application for exemption from filing official translations is not this exemption. Seals and stamps are often missing from OCR; check the visual detections for the copying seal.
Return not_applicable when the filing type, document type, or procedural prerequisite for this check is not established; trigger words alone do not establish applicability. Return defect_found only when the shown impugned judgment/order is positively uncertified, such as a website print or a copy marked only "TRUE COPY", and the applications shown in this matter seek other relief; quote the uncertified copy's endorsement or footer. The Affidavit usually affirms that "the Annexures are true copies of their respective originals". Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) each Annexure being a certified copy of a document forming part of the record of the Court or Tribunal sought to be appealed from or, (b) for any Annexure that is uncertified, an affirmation that it is a true copy.

defects.ai_note:

Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a finding whether the matter involves a sentence of imprisonment and, if so, (b) a statement that the convict has surrendered or (c) an application for exemption from surrender.
Do not treat a sentence of fine only, or custody as an undertrial, as a sentence of imprisonment. Do not treat an exemption from filing a certified copy as exemption from surrender.

defects.ai_note:

Return compliant according to the compliance instruction below. A Vakalatnama executed from jail carries the accused's signature or thumb impression with a date, often "Dated this day of", and an attestation such as "Attested" or "Signed before me" by the Jail Superintendent or Superintendent of Jail, with the jail's seal and a date. Return compliant when both dates are legible and the attestation is dated the same day or later. Return needs_review when the Vakalatnama is not in the excerpts, either date is blank or illegible, or only one date is shown.

Return needs_review when custody status, any petitioner's proof or the application is not in the excerpts.

defects.defect: Copy of FIR required for anticipatory bail is not filed
defects.requirement: In an anticipatory bail matter, a copy of the FIR must be filed with the petition, among its Annexures.
defects.trigger_words: FIRST INFORMATION REPORT; FIR No; Police Station; anticipatory bail; Under Sections; Date and time of occurrence
where_to_look: Annexures: copy of the FIR, with its number and police station
Main Petition: FIR number, date, police station and sections invoked
The FIR form headed "FIRST INFORMATION REPORT" with fields such as "FIR No.", "Police Station", "Date" and "Acts and Sections".
The FIR whose number, date, police station and sections match those stated in the Main Petition or the anticipatory bail application, not an FIR of another case.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for the User to upload a copy of the FIR.
defects.ivan_comment: CLEAR, TYPED AND TRANSLATED COPY OF THE FIR is required
defects.ai_note:
An FIR is a police form headed "FIRST INFORMATION REPORT" (OCR: "F.I.R.", "FIRST INFORMATON REPORT") with fields such as "District", "P.S." or "Police Station", "FIR No.", "Date" and "Act(s) and Section(s)"; a blank field is not printed in its row. The Main Petition or the anticipatory bail application states the FIR number, date, police station and sections. Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a copy of the FIR among the Annexures and (b) its number, date, police station and sections matching those stated in the Main Petition or the application.
A paragraph of the Main Petition that recites the FIR, a charge sheet, or the High Court's order narrating the FIR is not a copy of the FIR. An FIR of another case or police station does not meet this requirement.
Return not_applicable when the excerpts show the matter is not one for anticipatory bail. Return defect_found only when an FIR is shown whose number, date or police station differs from the one stated in the Main Petition or application; quote both. Return compliant when an FIR matching those particulars is shown; quote its number line. Return needs_review when no FIR or no FIR particulars are in the excerpts, or they are illegible.

defects.defect: Charge Sheet & Bail Dismissal/Disposal Order passed by Trial Court for regular bail/cancellation of bail matters is not filed
defects.requirement: In a regular bail or cancellation of bail matter, the Annexures must include the Charge Sheet and the Bail Dismissal/Disposal Order passed by the Trial Court.
defects.trigger_words: CHARGE SHEET; Final Report; Sessions Judge; regular bail; cancellation of bail; bail application is dismissed
where_to_look: Annexures: Charge Sheet filed before the Trial Court
Main Petition: Trial Court's bail dismissal or disposal order cited
The Charge Sheet or "Final Report" form with the police station, FIR number and accused named, and a Trial Court order on the bail application or the cancellation plea with its case number and date.
The copies filed must match the Charge Sheet and Trial Court order particulars stated in the Main Petition or application, not orders of another court or case.
how_to_cure: Option for the User to upload the Charge Sheet and the Trial Court's Bail Dismissal/Disposal Order.
defects.notes:
1. The Charge Sheet is required in both regular bail and cancellation of bail matters 
2. In cancellation of bail matters, the relevant Disposal Order passed by the Trial Court must be filed.
3. In regular bail matters, the Bail Dismissal Order passed by the Trial Court must be filed along with the order dismissing the bail application.
defects.ivan_comment: AS A MATTER OF BEST PRACTICE THE CHARGESHEET SHOULD BE FILED; SOMETIMES THE REGISTRY DOES NOT MARK IT AS A DEFECT; BUT STILL FOR OUR PURPOSES WE MUST FLAG IT]
defects.ai_note:
A Charge Sheet is a police report often headed "CHARGE SHEET" or "Final Report" naming the police station, FIR number and accused. The Trial Court's order is headed with the Sessions or Magistrate's court, case number and date, and ends with words such as "bail application is dismissed" or "disposed of". Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a copy of the Charge Sheet, (b) in a regular bail matter the Trial Court's Bail Dismissal Order, filed along with the order dismissing the bail application, or in a cancellation of bail matter the Trial Court's Disposal Order and (c) their particulars matching those stated in the Main Petition or application.
A recital in the Main Petition is not a copy, an FIR is not a Charge Sheet, and a High Court bail order is not the Trial Court's order.
Return not_applicable when the excerpts show the matter is neither a regular bail nor a cancellation of bail matter. Return defect_found only when a shown copy is of another case or court, or its particulars contradict the Main Petition; quote it. Return compliant when the Charge Sheet and the required Trial Court order are shown with matching particulars. Return needs_review when either document is not in the excerpts or is illegible.

defects.defect: Order of Trial Court in Conviction matters is not filed
defects.requirement: In a conviction matter, the Trial Court's judgment/order of conviction must be filed among the Annexures.
defects.trigger_words: JUDGMENT OF CONVICTION; ORDER ON SENTENCE; Sessions Case No; convicted under Section; sentenced to undergo; Additional Sessions Judge
where_to_look: Annexures: Trial Court's judgment or order of conviction
Main Petition: particulars of the Trial Court's conviction order
The Trial Court's heading, such as "IN THE COURT OF THE SESSIONS JUDGE" with "Sessions Case No.", and the operative lines "convicted under Section" and "sentenced to undergo".
The conviction order whose court, case number and date match those stated in the Main Petition, not the High Court's appellate judgment.
how_to_cure: Option for the User to upload a copy of the Trial Court order.
defects.ai_note:
The Trial Court's judgment of conviction is headed with the Sessions or Magistrate's court and a case number such as "Sessions Case No." or "S.C. No.", and ends with an "ORDER ON SENTENCE" or lines such as "the accused is convicted under Section" and "sentenced to undergo". OCR may read "Sesssions" or "convicted u/s". Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a copy of the Trial Court's order of conviction among the Annexures and (b) its court, case number and date matching those stated in the Main Petition.
The High Court's judgment in appeal, which is usually the impugned order, is not the Trial Court's order even when it quotes it at length. A bail order of the Trial Court is not the order of conviction.
Return not_applicable when the excerpts show the matter involves no conviction. Return defect_found only when a shown Trial Court order is of another case or contradicts the particulars in the Main Petition; quote its heading. Return compliant when the Trial Court's conviction order matching those particulars is shown; quote its operative line. Return needs_review when the Trial Court's order is not in the excerpts or is illegible.

defects.defect: Needs legal verification: the FIR or quashing order required for the particular criminal filing and the applicable CrPC/BNSS transitional regime has not been established in the record.

Do not retroactively replace the CrPC provision in a 2022 direction without transitional analysis.

where_to_look: Main Petition: date and nature of the underlying criminal proceeding, the relief sought, and whether the matter invokes Section 482 CrPC or Section 528 BNSS.
Annexures: complete FIR and the High Court quashing order, matched by FIR number, police station, case number, parties, and date.
Current Supreme Court rule, checklist, or circular and the applicable transitional provision for the date of the proceeding.

defects.notes:
Section 482, CRPC - Saving of inherent powers of High Court.—
Nothing in this Code shall be deemed to limit or affect the inherent powers of the High Court to make such orders as may be necessary to give effect to any order under this Code, or to prevent abuse of the process of any Court or otherwise to secure the ends of justice.

If quashed then what is the requirement for filing quashing order and what is the requirement for copy?


BECAUSE THE PERSON CHALLENGING THAT QUASHING ORDER WILL HAVE TO ATTACH IT AS THE IMPUGNED JUDGMENT]
defects.ai_note:
Legal status: Needs legal verification. This status does not prevent a compliant finding when complete, legible filing evidence affirmatively satisfies every stated element. Return compliant according to the compliance instruction below. Until a current authoritative rule, form, circular, practice direction, statute, or binding judgment confirms the obligation and its applicability, convert any otherwise defect_found outcome to needs_review. Also return needs_review when any prerequisite evidence is unavailable.
The FIR is a police form headed "FIRST INFORMATION REPORT" with "FIR No.", "P.S." or "Police Station", the date and "Act(s) and Section(s)". A quashing order is the High Court's order on a petition under Section 482 CrPC or Section 528 BNSS, often numbered "CRL.M.C.", "CRM-M" or "Crl. O.P.", refusing or granting the prayer to quash the FIR or proceedings. Labels may be wrong; identify each document by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a copy of the FIR among the Annexures and, where the matter arises from proceedings under Section 482 CrPC/Section 528 BNSS, (b) the quashing order, with (c) their particulars matching those stated in the Main Petition.
A paragraph of the Main Petition reciting the FIR is not a copy of it. A charge sheet is not the FIR, and an order on bail is not a quashing order.
Return not_applicable when the excerpts show the matter arises neither from an FIR nor from proceedings under Section 482 CrPC/Section 528 BNSS. After legal verification is completed, return defect_found only when a shown FIR or quashing order belongs to another case or contradicts the particulars in the Main Petition; quote it. Return compliant when the FIR and, where required, the quashing order are shown with matching particulars. Return needs_review when either is not in the excerpts or is illegible.

defects.defect: Custody Certificate in case of conviction is not filed
defects.requirement: Where the matter involves a conviction, a Custody Certificate must be filed.
defects.trigger_words: undergoing sentence; Jail Superintendent; Superintendent of Jail; period of custody; lodged in; remission
where_to_look: Custody Certificate: certificate from the jail for the convict
Main Petition: whether the matter involves a conviction
The jail officer's certificate stating the convict's name, the sentence, the period of custody undergone and the date, with the Superintendent's signature and seal.
The certificate naming this convict and case, not a custody certificate of a co-accused or another case.
how_to_cure: 1. Option for the User to attach/upload the Custody Certificate with Jubeex in cases involving conviction.

defects.ai_note:
A Custody Certificate is issued by the Superintendent of the jail and states that the convict is lodged there, the sentence, the period of custody undergone, often with and without remission, and any period remaining, with the jail seal. OCR may read it as "Custody Certficate" or "Custodv Certificate". Labels may be wrong; identify the Custody Certificate by its own heading and cause title.
Compliance needs (a) a finding that the matter involves a conviction and, if so, (b) a Custody Certificate on the file for the convict.
A statement in the Main Petition about the period undergone is not a Custody Certificate. A certificate of a co-accused does not serve for this convict. Seals and signatures are often missing from OCR; check the visual detections for them.
Return not_applicable when the excerpts show no conviction, such as a pre-trial bail matter. Return defect_found only when a conviction is shown and the only certificate shown relates to someone else or another case; quote its name line. Return compliant when a Custody Certificate for the convict is shown; quote its name and custody lines. Return needs_review when the conviction or the certificate cannot be read in the excerpts.

defects.defect: Custody certificate in all bail matters except Anticipatory bail matters, is not filed
defects.requirement: In every bail matter except an anticipatory bail matter, a Custody Certificate relating to the accused must be filed.
defects.trigger_words: anticipatory bail; regular bail; in custody since; Jail Superintendent; period of custody; lodged in
where_to_look: Custody Certificate: jail certificate for the accused in custody
Main Petition: prayer showing whether the bail sought is anticipatory
The prayer clause and the nature of the Main Petition or bail application, such as "grant anticipatory bail" or "release on bail", to see whether the matter is for anticipatory bail.
A Custody Certificate signed by the jail officer naming the accused in this bail matter, with the jail and the period of custody.
how_to_cure: Option for the User to upload the Custody Certificate with Jubeex.
